Romeu Zema (Novo) deixou o cargo até 4/4/2026 para concorrer à Presidência da República. Mateus Simões (PSD), vice-governador, assumiu.

MT.motivo_troca: Mauro Mendes (União Brasil) deixou o cargo até 4/4/2026 para concorrer ao Senado. Otaviano Pivetta (Republicanos), vice-governador, assumiu.

PA.motivo_troca: Helder Barbalho (MDB) deixou o cargo até 4/4/2026 para concorrer ao Senado. Hana Ghassan (MDB), vice-governadora, assumiu.

PB.motivo_troca: João Azevêdo (PSB) deixou o cargo até 4/4/2026 para concorrer ao Senado. Lucas Ribeiro (PP), vice-governador, assumiu.

PE.motivo_troca: Eduardo Campos (PSB) renunciou em abril de 2014 (posse do sucessor em 4/4/2014) para concorrer à Presidência da República; morreu em acidente aéreo em 13/8/2014, já como ex-governador. João Lyra Neto (PSB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

PE.obs: Raquel Lyra foi eleita em 2022 pelo PSDB e mudou para o PSD em março de 2025 (sem troca de titular).

PI.motivo_troca: Wellington Dias (PT) renunciou em 31/3/2022 para concorrer ao Senado. Regina Sousa (PT), vice-governadora, completou o mandato.

PR.motivo_troca: Beto Richa foi eleito em 2014 pelo PSDB, mudou para o PP ainda no mandato, e renunciou em 2018 para concorrer nas eleições daquele ano; Cida Borghetti (PP), vice-governadora, completou o mandato.

RJ.motivo_troca: Sérgio Cabral (PMDB) renunciou em 3/4/2014; motivo político não detalhado no comunicado oficial (fundamentado apenas em dispositivos constitucionais). Luiz Fernando Pezão (PMDB), vice-governador, tomou posse em 4/4/2014 e completou o mandato até 31/12/2014.

Wilson Witzel (PSC) foi afastado preventivamente em 28/8/2020 e destituído por impeachment em 30/4/2021 (condenado por unanimidade, 10 votos a 0). Cláudio Castro, vice-governador, tornou-se governador.
RJ.obs: Cláudio Castro já exercia o cargo interinamente desde o afastamento preventivo de Witzel em 28/8/2020.

RJ.motivo_troca: Cláudio Castro (PL) foi condenado pelo TSE em 23/3/2026 (cassação e inelegibilidade até 2030, por abuso de poder político e econômico na campanha de reeleição de 2022) e renunciou/deixou o cargo nesse contexto. Como o vice-governador eleito, Thiago Pampolha, já havia deixado o posto (nomeado ao Tribunal de Contas do Estado) e o presidente da Alerj também estava afastado, o desembargador Rodrigo Couto de Castro, presidente do Tribunal de Justiça do RJ, assumiu interinamente. Em 26/3/2026, Douglas Ruas (PL) foi eleito presidente da Alerj e assumiu o governo na prática. Até a data desta coleta (setembro de 2026), a forma da sucessão definitiva do cargo (eleição direta ou indireta) permanecia em disputa entre TSE e STF, sem desfecho confirmado nas fontes consultadas.

sucessores.obs: presidente da Alerj, exerce o governo na prática; situação de sucessão definitiva não resolvida na data da coleta

RJ.obs: Situação jurídica ainda não definitivamente resolvida nas fontes consultadas em setembro de 2026; datas de 23 e 26/3/2026 conforme reportagem da Agência Brasil, mas outra fonte consultada (O Tempo) menciona também uma data de renúncia em 3/4/2026, possivelmente referente a um passo processual distinto (prazo de desincompatibilização para candidatura ao Senado); não foi possível reconciliar completamente as datas entre as fontes nesta coleta.

RO.motivo_troca: Confúcio Moura (MDB) renunciou em 2018 para concorrer nas eleições daquele ano; Daniel Pereira (PSB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

RR.motivo_troca: José de Anchieta Júnior (PSDB) deixou o cargo em 4/4/2014; Chico Rodrigues (PSB), vice-governador, assumiu e foi por sua vez alvo de impeachment em 1/12/2014, faltando cerca de um mês para o fim do mandato. Não foi possível confirmar nesta coleta quem exerceu o cargo entre 1/12/2014 e 31/12/2014 (provavelmente a presidência da Assembleia Legislativa, conforme praxe constitucional, mas isso não foi verificado em fonte primária).
RR.obs: Terceiro trecho do mandato (1 a 31/12/2014) não confirmado em fonte consultada nesta coleta.

RR.obs: Data exata da intervenção federal varia entre 7 e 10/12/2018 conforme a fonte.

RR.motivo_troca: Antônio Denarium, eleito em 2022 pelo PP e filiado ao Republicanos por ocasião da renúncia, deixou o cargo até 4/4/2026 para concorrer ao Senado. Edilson Damião (Republicanos), vice-governador, assumiu.

RS.motivo_troca: Eduardo Leite (PSDB) renunciou em 31/3/2022 para eventualmente disputar outro cargo (não especificado no momento da renúncia); acabou concorrendo à reeleição ao governo do estado em outubro de 2022 e venceu. Ranolfo Vieira Júnior (PSDB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

SC.motivo_troca: Raimundo Colombo (PSD) renunciou em 2018 para concorrer nas eleições daquele ano; Eduardo Pinho Moreira (MDB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

SE.motivo_troca: Marcelo Déda (PT) morreu em 2/12/2013, em decorrência de câncer. Jackson Barreto (PMDB), vice-governador, assumiu e completou o mandato.
Jackson Barreto (MDB) renunciou em 2018 para concorrer nas eleições daquele ano; Belivaldo Chagas (PSD), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

SP.motivo_troca: Geraldo Alckmin (PSDB) renunciou em 2018 para concorrer à Presidência da República; Márcio França (PSB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.
João Doria (PSDB) renunciou em 31/3/2022 para concorrer à Presidência da República (candidatura depois retirada). Rodrigo Garcia (PSDB), vice-governador, completou o mandato.

TO.motivo_troca: Siqueira Campos (PSDB) deixou o cargo por volta de maio de 2014 (fontes divergem entre 4 e 9/5/2014); segundo a Wikipédia em inglês, Sandoval Cardoso (SD) foi 'eleito indiretamente pela Assembleia Legislativa' para completar o mandato até 31/12/2014, já que a linha sucessória normal (vice-governador) não estava disponível.
TO.obs: Datas de início/fim da troca apresentam pequena divergência entre fontes consultadas (4 ou 9 de maio de 2014); não foi possível confirmar com precisão qual a data exata nesta coleta.

TO.motivo_troca: O mandato de Marcelo Miranda (PMDB) foi cassado judicialmente (revogado pela segunda vez em 22/3/2018, segundo a Wikipédia em inglês); Mauro Carlesse (PHS) venceu o pleito suplementar realizado em 2018 e completou o mandato.

marcos_tributarios.fonte_geral: Official Gazette of the Union / Planalto portal (planalto.gov.br) for laws, constitutional amendments, provisional measures and federal decrees; Federal Senate (senado.leg.br) for acts of the Senate's legislative process. Each milestone below cites the specific official URL consulted.
notas: Coverage: 1998-2026, federal taxes and contributions; Constitutional Amendment 95/2016 (the spending cap) is a fiscal rule, not a tax, and is marked as type 'regra_fiscal'.
Each item describes what the act did, without a value judgement on the measure or attribution of the change in the tax burden to any particular administration.

Where a measure is popularly attributed to an administration but the formal act belongs to another branch (as with the non-extension of the CPMF in 2007), the item describes who performed the act: the Federal Senate, rejecting the amendment that would have extended the levy.

Items requested that did NOT make it in, for lack of confirmation in an official source consulted: (1) a change to the financial-operations tax (IOF) published in 2026 — no 2026 decree or law on the IOF was located on planalto.gov.br up to the collection date (September 2026); the 2025 IOF decrees (Decree 12,466/2025 and Decree 12,499/2025) are included. (2) Specific 2026 implementing rules for Constitutional Amendment 132/2023 (e.g. the decree regulating the CBS, cited in an April 2026 Planalto news item) were not verified in full text and did not enter as a separate item.

The dates in 'quando' (decimal year.fraction format) are approximations of the position within the calendar year, calculated from the month of the act and used only to place the milestones on a timeline; the precise factual date of each act is in the 'ato' field and in the source.

marcos.titulo: Creation of the CPMF
marcos.o_que: Created the Provisional Contribution on Financial Transactions (CPMF), at a rate of 0.20% on financial movements.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 9.311, de 24 de outubro de 1996

marcos.titulo: First extension of the CPMF, at a rate of 0.38%
marcos.o_que: Extended the CPMF levy for thirty-six months and changed the rate to 0.38% for the first twelve months and 0.30% for the months that followed.
marcos.ato: Emenda Constitucional nº 21, de 18 de março de 1999
marcos.nome: First extension of the CPMF, at a rate of 0.38%

marcos.titulo: Creation of the Cide fuel levy
marcos.o_que: Created the Contribution for Intervention in the Economic Domain levied on the import and sale of oil and its derivatives, natural gas and its derivatives, and fuel ethanol (Cide-Combustíveis).
marcos.ato: Lei nº 10.336, de 19 de dezembro de 2001
marcos.nome: Creation of the Cide fuel levy

marcos.titulo: Second extension of the CPMF, to 2004
marcos.o_que: Extended the CPMF levy to 31 December 2004, at a rate of 0.38% in the 2002 and 2003 financial years and 0.08% in 2004.
marcos.ato: Emenda Constitucional nº 37, de 12 de junho de 2002
marcos.nome: Second extension of the CPMF, to 2004

marcos.titulo: Non-cumulative PIS
marcos.o_que: Created the non-cumulative PIS/Pasep contribution, at a rate of 1.65% on revenue, allowing credits calculated on goods and services bought as inputs to be deducted.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 10.637, de 30 de dezembro de 2002

marcos.titulo: Third extension of the CPMF, to 2007
marcos.o_que: Extended the CPMF levy to 31 December 2007, keeping the rate at 0.38%.
marcos.ato: Emenda Constitucional nº 42, de 19 de dezembro de 2003
marcos.nome: Third extension of the CPMF, to 2007

marcos.titulo: Non-cumulative Cofins
marcos.o_que: Created the non-cumulative Cofins, at a rate of 7.6% on revenue, allowing credits calculated on costs and expenses tied to production or the supply of services to be deducted.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 10.833, de 29 de dezembro de 2003

marcos.titulo: Senate rejects a further extension of the CPMF
marcos.o_que: The Federal Senate rejected, in a vote on 13 December 2007 (45 in favour and 34 against, four votes short of the three-fifths quorum required), Constitutional Amendment Proposal 89/2007, which would have extended the CPMF financial-transactions levy beyond 31 December 2007. With no new extension approved, collection of the CPMF ceased on 1 January 2008, when the deadline set by Constitutional Amendment 42/2003 expired.
marcos.ato: Rejeição, pelo Plenário do Senado Federal, da Proposta de Emenda à Constituição nº 89, de 2007 (PEC 89/2007), em 13/12/2007
marcos.nome: Senate rejects a further extension of the CPMF

marcos.titulo: IPI cut for the car industry
marcos.o_que: Set out a cut of up to 30 percentage points in the industrial-products tax on vehicles, tractors and auto parts, conditional on requirements such as a minimum 65% regional content and investment in innovation, with rates differentiated by period between 2011 and 2013.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 7.567, de 15 de setembro de 2011
marcos.nome: IPI cut for the car industry

marcos.titulo: Payroll-tax relief
marcos.o_que: Created, for sectors such as information technology, hotels, transport and construction, a substitute social-security contribution levied on gross revenue (rates between 1% and 4.5%) in place of the employer contribution on payroll set out in Law 8,212/1991.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 12.546, de 14 de dezembro de 2011

marcos.titulo: Spending cap (New Fiscal Regime)
marcos.o_que: Amended the Transitional Constitutional Provisions to create the New Fiscal Regime, setting individual ceilings for the primary spending of the Executive, Legislature, Judiciary, Public Prosecutor's Office and Public Defender's Office, adjusted annually for inflation (IPCA), for up to twenty financial years. It is not a tax; it is a spending-limit rule.
marcos.ato: Emenda Constitucional nº 95, de 15 de dezembro de 2016

marcos.titulo: PIS/Cofins cut to zero on diesel and domestic cooking gas
marcos.o_que: Amended Decree 5,059/2004 to cut to R$ 0.00 the specific PIS/Pasep and Cofins rates on the import and sale of diesel and on LPG for domestic use in containers of up to 13 kg.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 10.638, de 1º de março de 2021
marcos.nome: PIS/Cofins cut to zero on diesel and domestic cooking gas

marcos.titulo: General cut in IPI rates
marcos.o_que: Amended the industrial-products tax schedule (TIPI), cutting by 18.5% the rates on products under heading 87.03 (passenger cars) and by 25% the rates on all other codes, except the products of Chapter 24 (tobacco).
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 10.979, de 25 de fevereiro de 2022

marcos.titulo: Single-stage ICMS on fuels
marcos.o_que: Established that ICMS would be levied only once (single-stage regime) on petrol, anhydrous fuel ethanol, diesel, biodiesel and LPG, with specific rates set uniformly nationwide by agreement among the states and the Federal District.
marcos.ato: Lei Complementar nº 192, de 11 de março de 2022

marcos.titulo: IPI cut widened from 25% to 35%
marcos.o_que: Amended the industrial-products tax schedule (TIPI), widening the linear rate cut to 35% (18.5% for the passenger cars of code 87.03), effective from 1 May 2022. The size of the cut is not written into the text of the decree, which refers to the annex of rates; 35% is the figure released by the government and the press at the time.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 11.055, de 28 de abril de 2022

marcos.titulo: ICMS capped on essential goods and services (LC 194/2022)
marcos.o_que: Classified fuels, natural gas, electricity, communications and public transport as essential and indispensable goods and services, barring states from setting an ICMS rate on those items above the rate applied to transactions in general.
marcos.ato: Lei Complementar nº 194, de 23 de junho de 2022
marcos.nome: ICMS capped on essential goods and services (LC 194/2022)

marcos.titulo: New tax schedule, with the IPI cut consolidated (the “4,000 products” decree)
marcos.nome: New tax schedule, with the IPI cut consolidated (the “4,000 products” decree)
marcos.o_que: Approved the new industrial-products tax schedule (TIPI), in force since 1 August 2022, consolidating the rate cut already in effect. This is the act behind the phrase “Bolsonaro cut 4,000 taxes”: the cut reached about 4,000 product codes in the schedule — products, not taxes. Neither the number of products nor the 35% figure appears in the text of the decree, which carries only the annex of rates.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 11.158, de 29 de julho de 2022

marcos.titulo: IPI restored on products also made in the Manaus Free Trade Zone
marcos.nome: IPI restored on products also made in the Manaus Free Trade Zone
marcos.o_que: Amended the industrial-products tax schedule approved by Decree 11,158/2022 to restore the previous rates on a set of products that are also made in the Manaus Free Trade Zone, after complaints about the industrial hub losing its competitive advantage. It is a partial reversal of the previous month's cut.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 11.182, de 24 de agosto de 2022

marcos.titulo: PIS/Cofins/Cide cut on petrol, ethanol, vehicular gas and aviation kerosene
marcos.o_que: Cut the specific PIS/Pasep and Cofins rates on petrol, ethanol, vehicular natural gas and aviation kerosene, and cut to zero the Cide levy on petrol and its blends (except aviation), in force until 30 June 2023.
marcos.ato: Medida Provisória nº 1.163, de 28 de fevereiro de 2023
marcos.nome: PIS/Cofins/Cide cut on petrol, ethanol, vehicular gas and aviation kerosene

marcos.titulo: Deadline for the zero PIS/Cofins rate on diesel, biodiesel and cooking gas
marcos.nome: Deadline for the zero PIS/Cofins rate on diesel, biodiesel and cooking gas
marcos.o_que: Set 31 December 2023 as the deadline for the zero PIS/Cofins rate on diesel, biodiesel and cooking gas. There was no new act reimposing the charge on 1 January 2024: collection resumed simply because this deadline expired — a case of a tax rising with no act signed at all.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.592, de 30 de maio de 2023 (conversão da Medida Provisória nº 1.147/2022)

marcos.titulo: IPI on firearms and ammunition
marcos.o_que: Amended the industrial-products tax schedule, restoring the rate on firearms to 55% and on cartridges and ammunition to 25%. The previous levels, 29.25% and 13%, came from a decree of April 2022.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 11.764, de 31 de outubro de 2023

marcos.titulo: Import tax back on electric and hybrid vehicles
marcos.nome: Import tax back on electric and hybrid vehicles
marcos.o_que: Reinstated, from January 2024, the import tax on electrified vehicles, which had been zero, rising in steps: electric from 10% to 18%, 25% and 35%; hybrids from 12% to 25%, 30% and 35%. The calendar was changed later: in July 2025 the Gecex trade committee ruled on a new date for the full 35% tariff, so the original schedule does not describe the rule in force today.
marcos.ato: Resolução do Comitê-Executivo de Gestão da Camex (Gecex), aprovada em 10 de novembro de 2023 e publicada no Diário Oficial da União em 23 de novembro de 2023 — número da resolução não localizado em fonte oficial

marcos.titulo: New taxation of exclusive funds and offshore holdings
marcos.o_que: Created periodic taxation (“come-cotas”) for closed-end and exclusive investment funds in Brazil and taxation, at 15%, of investment income and profits of entities controlled abroad earned by individuals resident in the country, along with reporting obligations on assets held abroad.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.754, de 12 de dezembro de 2023
marcos.nome: New taxation of exclusive funds and offshore holdings

marcos.titulo: Consumption tax reform (CBS, IBS and the Selective Tax)
marcos.o_que: Amended the National Tax System to create the Social Contribution on Goods and Services (CBS, federal) and the Tax on Goods and Services (IBS, state and municipal), plus a Selective Tax, providing for the gradual extinction of PIS, Cofins and IPI (federal) and of ICMS and ISS (state/municipal) over a transition running from tests in 2026 to the extinction of ICMS and ISS in 2033.
marcos.ato: Emenda Constitucional nº 132, de 20 de dezembro de 2023
marcos.nome: Consumption tax reform (CBS, IBS and the Selective Tax)

marcos.titulo: Taxation of fixed-odds betting (the “bets”)
marcos.o_que: Regulated fixed-odds betting and allocated 12% of the operators' takings, after prizes paid and income tax are deducted, to public purposes; net prizes received by the bettor became subject to 15% income tax. A provisional measure of June 2025 would have raised the operators' rate to 18%, but it lapsed in October 2025 without being converted into law: the 12% still stands.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.790, de 29 de dezembro de 2023

marcos.titulo: New import tax rates on international parcels
marcos.o_que: Amended Decree-Law 1,804/1980 to set an import tax rate of 20% on international parcels up to US$ 50.00 and 60% (with a US$ 20.00 deduction) on parcels from US$ 50.01 to US$ 3,000.00, within the Green Mobility and Innovation Programme (Programa Mover).
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.902, de 27 de junho de 2024
marcos.nome: New import tax rates on international parcels

marcos.titulo: Payroll-tax relief wound down for 17 sectors
marcos.nome: Payroll-tax relief wound down for 17 sectors
marcos.o_que: Wound down in stages the payroll-tax relief for the 17 sectors that employ the most people: the contribution on gross revenue falls to 80% in 2025, 60% in 2026 and 40% in 2027 of the previous rates, while the employer contribution on payroll rises to 25%, 50% and 75% of the normal rates, reaching the full payroll charge in 2028. The relief had been extended by Congress in 2023, overriding a presidential veto.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.973, de 16 de setembro de 2024

marcos.titulo: Implementing law for the IBS, the CBS and the Selective Tax
marcos.o_que: Created the Tax on Goods and Services (IBS), the Social Contribution on Goods and Services (CBS) and the Selective Tax (IS), implementing Constitutional Amendment 132/2023, with a test phase from 2026, the start of CBS collection in 2027 and a schedule of IBS reference rates running to 2033.
marcos.ato: Lei Complementar nº 214, de 16 de janeiro de 2025
marcos.nome: Implementing law for the IBS, the CBS and the Selective Tax

marcos.titulo: IOF rates changed (May 2025)
marcos.o_que: Amended Decree 6,306/2007 (the IOF financial-operations tax regulation), creating an additional rate of 0.95% (companies) and 0.38% (individuals and micro-entrepreneurs) on credit operations, setting a 3.5% rate for several outbound foreign-exchange operations and changing the taxation of life insurance with survival cover (VGBL).
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 12.466, de 22 de maio de 2025

marcos.titulo: IOF rates revised again (June 2025)
marcos.o_que: Again amended Decree 6,306/2007, replacing the additional 0.95% rate on credit operations with a single 0.38% rate regardless of the operation's term, creating a reduced foreign-exchange rate of 1.10% for investment transfers abroad and setting a 0.38% rate on primary acquisitions of shares in receivables investment funds (FIDC), after a reaction from Congress and Supreme Court decisions on the May 2025 decree.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 12.499, de 11 de junho de 2025

marcos.titulo: Income-tax exemption up to R$ 5,000 and a minimum tax on high incomes
marcos.nome: Income-tax exemption up to R$ 5,000 and a minimum tax on high incomes
marcos.o_que: Exempted from income tax earnings up to R$ 5,000 a month, with a tapering discount that reaches zero at R$ 7,350, and created in exchange a minimum tax on high incomes, with a maximum rate of 10%, from R$ 600,000 of annual income. It is the only act on this list that cuts and raises at the same time, in different taxpayer brackets — which is why it appears only once, classified by the end that reaches more people.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 15.270, de 26 de novembro de 2025

marcos.titulo: Financial-sector profit tax, tax on interest on equity and a cut in tax benefits
marcos.nome: Financial-sector profit tax, tax on interest on equity and a cut in tax benefits
marcos.o_que: Reorganised the social contribution on net profit (CSLL) for the financial sector: banks stay at 20% and insurers and brokerages at 15%, while credit, financing and investment companies go to 17.5% (20% from 2028) and payment institutions — fintechs — go to 12% (15% from 2028); these last two came from the general 9% rate. Raised withholding tax on interest on equity from 15% to 17.5% and ordered a linear 10% cut in federal tax benefits and incentives.
marcos.ato: Lei Complementar nº 224, de 26 de dezembro de 2025

marcos.titulo: End of the “parcel tax”
marcos.o_que: Cut to zero the import tax on international parcels up to US$ 50 and lowered from 60% to 30% the rate on the US$ 50 to US$ 3,000 band, undoing the charge created by Law 14,902/2024. The state ICMS on the same purchases remains.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 15.502, de 10 de setembro de 2026 (conversão da Medida Provisória nº 1.357, de 12 de maio de 2026)

fonte.nome: Bolognesi, B.; Ribeiro, E.; Codato, A. — “Uma Nova Classificação Ideológica dos Partidos Políticos Brasileiros”, Dados, v.66, n.2, 2023

partidos.metodo: Posição média atribuída a cada partido por 519 cientistas políticos filiados à Associação Brasileira de Ciência Política, consultados entre 1º e 20 de julho de 2018, numa escala de 0 (esquerda) a 10 (direita). Os autores dividem a escala em sete faixas, reproduzidas aqui.

PL.nota: o PL de hoje é o mesmo registro partidário que, em 2018, se chamava PR; a pesquisa o classificou sob o nome antigo

Republicanos.nota: classificado em 2018 sob o nome anterior, PRB

PP.nota: mesma legenda, classificada em 2018 como Progressistas

União Brasil.nota: partido criado em 2022 pela fusão de DEM e PSL; não existia quando a pesquisa foi feita, em 2018, e por isso não tem posição nessa escala

Missão.nota: legenda recente; não consta da pesquisa de 2018

PMDB.nota: PMDB era o nome do MDB até 2017; a pesquisa classificou a legenda pelo nome atual

etapas.o_que_e: Instrument signed at the moment the land settlement is created, between the INCRA and the settled family. It contains 'clauses setting out the rights and the obligations' the settler must comply with (use of the land, residence, productive exploitation) in order to progress later to a land titling…

etapas.nome: Concessão de Direito Real de Uso
etapas.o_que_e: A definitive instrument (it is not renewed like the CCU), but one that does not transfer ownership of the land to the beneficiary — used above all in environmentally differentiated projects (Projetos de Assentamento Agroextrativista - PAE, de Desenvolvimento Sustentável - PDS, Florestais). According to the…

Document that 'transfers the plots on a definitive basis, once compliance with the requirements of the CCU has been verified and it has been shown that the settlers are able to farm the land and pay for it'. It is the final stage: it turns the settler into an owner. Under art. 189 of the…

explicacao.ordem_do_processo: According to INCRA's own page on titling, the regular sequence is: settlement created -> Contrato de Concessão de Uso (CCU), provisional, signed at implementation -> fulfillment of the CCU obligations (georeferencing of the plot, proof of productive capacity and of ability to pay) -> issuance of the Título de Domínio (TD); in environmentally differentiated projects, the path leads to the CDRU instead…
explicacao.tempo_tipico: No official figure for the 'average time between settling and titling' was found. Indirect indications: at the end of 2017 INCRA/the federal government reported more than 600,000 families awaiting land titling (Agência Brasil, https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/geral/noticia/2018-02/governo-concedeu-mais-de-26-mil-titulos-de-propriedades-para-reforma-agraria); academic articles on specific land settlements report delays of years due to a lack of georeferencing and technical assistance (Retratos de Assentamentos, https://retratosdeassentamentos.com/index.php/retratos/article/view/613). There is no source with a measured national average time — see 'notas'.

a_favor.argumento: Titling gives the settled family legal certainty and broadens access to rural credit, technical assistance and public policies — the titling documents 'represent the recognition of the right of families that have been settled or that occupy public land', giving 'legal certainty and access to rural credit and technical assistance'.
a_favor.de_quem: INCRA (official note on the 400,000 land titling documents issued, Bolsonaro administration)

a_favor.argumento: Land regularization/land titling brings legal certainty to the countryside: according to the account, land regularization is something all sectors seek and, from the moment there are clear rules, there is far more assurance because of the legal certainty.
a_favor.de_quem: Maurício Saito, chair of the Comissão Nacional de Assuntos Fundiários of the CNA (Confederação da Agricultura e Pecuária do Brasil) —…

a_favor.argumento: The titles issued between 2019 and 2022 'have legal force' equivalent to those of earlier administrations, and the titling policy regularized the situation of 340 thousand families, which is said to have helped reduce the number of land invasions to historic lows (7 in 2019, 6 in 2020, 11 in 2021, against ~2,5 thousand in the…
a_favor.de_quem: Geraldo Melo Filho, former president of INCRA under the Bolsonaro administration

criticas.argumento: Of the documents announced as '420 thousand titles' between 2019 and September/2022, INCRA confirmed 370 thousand, of which 88% (326.745) were CCU — mostly mandatory five-yearly renewals of concessions already granted under earlier administrations, and not new titles — and only 12% (43.258) were definitive documents…
criticas.de_quem: MST (Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra), based on INCRA/SIPRA's own data

criticas.argumento: The Título de Domínio, because it can be sold once the conditions are met, favors the reconcentration of land: neighboring large landowners and land grabbers pressure — 'including with threats' — settled families to sell the lots for 'derisory amounts', which runs counter to the redistributive goal of agrarian reform. The…
criticas.de_quem: Academic research (Cadernos de Agroecologia/ABA), citing geographer Paulo Alentejano (UERJ) and the MST position that 'land titling is not…

criticas.argumento: Once titled, the settled families lose access to the subsidized credit of Pronaf A (intended for those who do not yet have a title) and face difficulty in obtaining private bank financing, which increases the pressure to sell the plot; an anthropologist interviewed for the report states that this will 'probably' increase the…
criticas.de_quem: Report by Repórter Brasil, citing anthropologist Igor Rolemberg and a source at an unidentified confederation

criticas.argumento: The documents delivered under the Bolsonaro administration were issued 'in a hasty, badly done way, without passing legislation', and were described, critically, as 'bread wrapping paper', that is, without proper legal value according to that assessment.
criticas.de_quem: Paulo Teixeira, minister of Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar in the Lula administration (from 2023 onward)

serie_anual.explicacao: No panel, dataset or official INCRA report was found publishing a continuous year-by-year series of 'titles issued' (TD/CDRU/CCU) as reusable open data. INCRA's Painel de Assentamentos (painel.incra.gov.br) offers panels on settled families, citizenship territories, the semi-arid region, the Amazônia Legal, social programs (CadÚnico, Bolsa Família, PAA, ATER) and the age of settlements, but no panel specific to land titling. INCRA's 'Dados Abertos' page (antigo.incra.gov.br/pt/dados-abertos.html) could not be accessed in this research (blocked by robots.txt), and a search of the Portal Brasileiro de Dados Abertos (dados.gov.br) returned no dataset of titling by year. What exists publicly is: (a) cumulative figures per administration, released in official INCRA statements and repeated by press fact-checks; (b) isolated announcements of title deliveries in specific municipalities; and (c) a few loose annual figures, cited in individual news reports, which do not amount to a consolidated official series.

pontos.obs: Number of titles issued in 2015 according to a Repórter Brasil report on budget cuts at INCRA; the report does not specify whether the figure covers only definitive titles or also CCU.
Number of titles issued in 2016 (a 502% rise over 2015) according to the same Repórter Brasil report; the same caveat applies as to the type of title.

More than 26,000 'definitive freehold titles, with the force of a public deed' issued in 2017 — ten times the historical average since 2003 and more than the sum of all definitive titles issued in the previous decade, according to INCRA and the federal government. In the same year more than 97,000 provisional titles (CCU) were granted, more than double the previous best result (47,000, in 2010).

Cited only as a comparative reference ('previous best result') for provisional titles (CCU) granted in a single year before 2017, in the same Agência Brasil report on the 2017 figures. It is not a figure for definitive titles.

por_governo.o_que_a_fonte_diz: 23.110 titles issued, according to a survey by the INCRA sent to the STF and cited in a CNN Brasil fact-check on land titling figures by administration. The source does not break down the composition by type of instrument (TD/CDRU/CCU).
99,048 titles issued, according to the same INCRA survey cited by CNN Brasil.

166.627 titles issued, according to the same INCRA survey cited by CNN Brasil. Same caveat: aggregate for the period, with no annual breakdown and no breakdown by type of instrument in the source consulted.

208.563 titles issued in the period, according to CNN Brasil (INCRA/STF). That total is consistent with the 2017 titling peak already recorded separately by Agência Brasil (>26 thousand definitive titles + >97 thousand CCU in 2017 alone), which suggests that the figure for the period includes both definitive titles and provisional CCUs.

The INCRA announced, in an official statement of 5/9/2022, that it had issued 404.993 'land titling documents' between January 2019 and August 2022 (of which 124.954 in 2022 alone up to that month). CNN Brasil, with a cut-off of June/2022, records 362.047 (280.107 in 2019-2021 + 81.940 up to June/2022).
No official figure for 'titles issued' under the Lula 3 administration comparable to the per-administration totals above was found in this research.

itens.data: 2023 (declaração pública, sem data exata de ato administrativo localizada)
itens.o_que: The Minister of Agrarian Development and Family Farming, Paulo Teixeira, publicly described the land titling documents issued under the Bolsonaro administration as issued 'in a hasty, badly done way, without passing legislation' and with no legal value ('bread wrapping paper').
itens.orgao: Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar (statement by the minister; no administrative act of repeal identified)

itens.data: 2023 (relatório do TCU sobre a Lista de Alto Risco da Administração Pública, tema 'Governança Territorial e Fundiária')
itens.o_que: The TCU ordered INCRA to investigate 'all indications of irregularities in the selection of beneficiaries' of the Programa Nacional de Reforma Agrária.

The Ministério Público Federal in Pará filed suit seeking the annulment of 3 titles to rural properties (Santo Antônio, Boa Sombra and São Raimundo) registered by a notary office in the Comarca de Muaná (PA), for lack of a record of the separation of the land from public property and for overlapping the Projeto de Assentamento Agroextrativista da Ilha Cajuúba, created by INCRA in 2014.

normas.ato: Launch of the Programa Titula Brasil (INCRA, Bolsonaro administration), regulated by an INCRA normative instruction
normas.o_que_mudou: Created a program to speed up the land regularization of rural properties, including through partnerships with municipal governments to speed up land titling/regularization processes. It was criticized by the CUT (Central Única dos Trabalhadores) and by the geographer Paulo Alentejano (cited in the study by the…

It restructured federal civil service careers, replacing the position of 'perito agrário federal' with the new position of 'perito territorial federal', and repealed statutory duties such as 'inspection, appraisal and technical assessment of rural properties to verify compliance with the social function of property' and the…

notas: The INCRA releases land titling mainly as a cumulative total per administration, in official statements and in replies to press fact-checks. No public file or dashboard with titles issued year by year was found — which is why this part appears as a table by period, and not as a line on the chart.

It was not possible to confirm, for the administration that began in 2023, a number of titles issued comparable to the totals of the earlier periods. The releases from that period speak of families included in the program and of plots ratified, which measure something else. The absence here is of a figure published in the same format, and is not proof that there was no policy.
Totals for the 2019-2022 period vary according to the source and the cutoff date, and are recorded in the table with the date of each one.

No official figure for the average time between settling and titling was found. Two pages that could have completed this research could not be opened: Instrução Normativa INCRA nº 124/2022 and the INCRA open data page.

estatisticas.titulo: ADIs decided on the merits by the STF and the outcome of the judgment
estatisticas.unidade: absolute number of cases and percentage found valid
estatisticas.orgao: Anuário da Justiça Brasil 2024 (Consultor Jurídico), with data attributed to the STF / management report of the STF presidency
estatisticas.metodologia: Count of all ADIs decided on the merits by the STF in the calendar year, classified by outcome (fully or partly upheld vs. dismissed); figure published in the 18th edition of the Anuário da Justiça Brasil (22/05/2024), which states that it used STF records and the management report of the then-president Rosa Weber as its basis.

fonte.nome: Consultor Jurídico - 'Mais da metade das ADIs apreciadas pelo STF em 2023 foi considerada procedente'

pontos.obs: 378 ADIs ruled on the merits in 2023; 217 (57%) upheld in whole or in part, the rest dismissed. In the same survey, 52 ADPFs were ruled on the merits, with 71% finding a violation of the Constitution (in whole or in part). Between Dec/2022 and Apr/2024 the backlog of pending concentrated constitutional review cases fell 20%, attributed to Emenda Regimental 58 (a 90-day deadline for returning a case taken for review). This figure measures ADIs RULED ON in the year, not ADIs FILED, and it does not break out how many specifically targeted acts of the federal government.

estatisticas.titulo: Provisional measures and decrees of the federal government challenged at the STF
estatisticas.orgao: Gazeta do Povo (its own journalistic survey; NOT an official statistic published by a government body, by the STF or by the AGU)
estatisticas.metodologia: The report cross-referenced the total number of provisional measures and decrees issued by the Bolsonaro administration in the first six months of the term (Jan-Jun/2019) with the direct actions (ADIs/ADPFs) filed at the STF against each of those acts, counting how many had been the target of at least one action.

fonte.nome: Gazeta do Povo - 'Bolsonaro tem 9 atos questionados no STF em 6 meses de gestão'

pontos.obs: 9 acts of the federal government challenged in the STF in the first 6 months of the Bolsonaro administration (Jan-Jun/2019): 6 of the 16 provisional measures issued in the period and 3 of the 182 decrees issued. One MP and one decree had already been suspended by the STF by the date of the report. Coverage limited to a single half-year of a single administration; there is no comparison with other periods in this same source.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary granted a preliminary injunction holding that the Constitution, even after Emenda Constitucional 20/1998, did not authorize charging a social security contribution on public servants already retired and on pensioners.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The government defended the levy, created by EC 20/1998 which it had itself proposed; the court struck it down.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The reporting justice granted an injunction recognizing a formal defect in the approval of Emenda Constitucional 19/1998 (administrative reform) in the part that amended article 39 of the Constitution, loosening the single legal regime for public servants. The injunction was only confirmed by the Plenary in 2007.
decisoes.orgao_julgador: Single-justice ruling (rapporteur), upheld by the Plenary only in 2007
decisoes.efeito_porque: The suspended provision was part of the administrative reform proposed by the government then in office.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary ruled constitutional the creation of the Conselho Nacional de Justiça by Emenda Constitucional 45/2004 (Judiciary Reform), rejecting the claim of a violation of the federative pact and of the separation of powers.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The Reforma do Judiciário amendment was a government priority and was upheld.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary, unanimously, rejected a motion for clarification and upheld the position that Emenda Constitucional 37/2002 merely extended the collection of the CPMF, with no need to observe the ninety-day period for a new levy.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The CPMF levy, which the government argued for keeping, was preserved.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary ruled constitutional article 5 of the Lei de Biossegurança (Lei 11.105/2005), which authorizes scientific research with embryonic stem cells obtained from unviable embryos or embryos frozen for more than three years.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The federal law defended by the federal government was held constitutional.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary approved, unanimously, Súmula Vinculante 13, prohibiting the appointment of a spouse, partner or relative up to the third degree to a commissioned post or position of trust in the direct and indirect public administration of the three Branches, at any federative level.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The binding precedent restricts appointments in all branches and at all levels; there was no federal government act under review.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary ruled on the merits and suspended the effect of article 2 of Emenda Constitucional 30/2000 (which amended art. 78 of the ADCT), which authorized the Public Treasury to pay in installments over up to ten years the precatórios outstanding on the date the amendment was enacted. The ruling was published on 19/05/2011.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The suspended provision authorized the public treasury to pay precatórios in installments, and the federal government was its beneficiary.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary, unanimously (10 votes, with Justice Dias Toffoli recused), ruled constitutional the reservation of places on ethnic-racial grounds in the selection process for admission to a public university, in this case the quota system of the Universidade de Brasília.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The quota policy was defended by the federal government, which took part in the case in favor of its constitutionality.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary ruled partially unconstitutional the special regime for the payment of federal, state and municipal precatórios established by Emenda Constitucional 62/2009. On 25/03/2015 the Plenary modulated the effects of that decision, extending the special regime for a further 5 fiscal years from 1º/01/2016 and changing the inflation adjustment index for ordinary precatórios from TR to IPCA-E.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The special precatórios regime, favorable to the public sector, was held partly unconstitutional.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary set the rules of procedure for the impeachment process of a President of the Republic: the special committee must be elected by open vote on a single slate nominated by the party leaders (no individual candidacies); the internal rules of the Câmara and the Senado apply subsidiarily, provided they are compatible with the Constitution; and the Câmara only authorizes the opening of the process, with the Senado deciding independently whether to accept the accusation.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The decision set the procedure for the impeachment of the president herself; classifying it as favorable or contrary to the government depends on which point of the procedure one looks at, and the ruling partly met both sides.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary, by 6 votes to 5, denied the preliminary injunction in ADCs 43 and 44, keeping the possibility of enforcing a sentence after a conviction upheld at second instance, even with appeals pending before the higher courts.
decisoes.efeito_porque: Criminal matter with no federal government act under review; the federal government was not a party defending a position of its own.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The rapporteur denied the writ of mandamus challenging the decree of federal intervention in public security in Rio de Janeiro issued by President Michel Temer, on the grounds that it was procedurally impossible for the petitioner to bring that action at the STF.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The intervention decree issued by the president was upheld, and the case was dismissed without a ruling on the merits.

decisoes.processo: Pet 6.834 (homologação do acordo de colaboração premiada da JBS)
decisoes.o_que_decidiu: A majority of the full court upheld the validity of the approval of the JBS plea bargain agreement granted by the rapporteur alone, holding that the initial review of the agreement's legality falls to the rapporteur justice, with the full bench subsequently examining the effectiveness of the agreement. The agreement provided the basis for the Polícia Federal investigation against President Michel Temer.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The approval that was upheld provided the basis for the investigation against the sitting president himself.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary, by 6 votes to 5, ruled on the merits and reversed its earlier position, deciding that a convicted person may only be imprisoned after all appeals have been exhausted (final and unappealable judgment), except for the possibility of pretrial detention under the requirements of the Código de Processo Penal.
decisoes.efeito_porque: Criminal matter with no federal government act under review.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: Justice Alexandre de Moraes, ruling as a single justice, suspended the appointment of Alexandre Ramagem as director-general of the Polícia Federal, pointing to signs of misuse of purpose in the presidential appointment.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The suspended appointment was an act of the President of the Republic.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The full court confirmed the interim injunction granted on March 24, 2020 by the rapporteur, Justice Marco Aurélio, establishing that the Union's authority to legislate on measures to confront Covid-19 does not displace the concurrent authority of the states, the Federal District and municipalities to adopt their own measures.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The federal government argued for centralizing the measures at the federal level; the court recognized concurrent powers of states and municipalities.

decisoes.processo: ADIs sobre os decretos presidenciais de armas de fogo de 2021
decisoes.o_que_decidiu: Justice Rosa Weber, ruling as a single justice, suspended parts of four presidential decrees on the possession and carrying of firearms issued in February 2021, among them the provision that raised from 2 to 6 the number of guns a civilian could own.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The suspended decrees were issued by the President of the Republic.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: Justice Flávio Dino, ruling as a single justice, suspended the execution of the mandatory parliamentary budget amendments until Congress established rules on transparency and traceability of the funds; the decision was upheld, unanimously, in an extraordinary virtual session of the Plenary on the same day.
decisoes.orgao_julgador: Single-justice ruling, upheld by the Plenary on the same day
decisoes.efeito_porque: The dispute was between Congress and the court over the transparency of the budget amendments; the Executive was not defending an act of its own, and the suspension affected the bargaining power of both sides.

decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The Plenary (virtual session) declared unconstitutional provisions of Emendas Constitucionais 113/2021 and 114/2021 that imposed a cap on the annual amount allocated by the Union to the payment of federal precatórios.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The federal government argued for ending the cap and the Advocacia-Geral da União maintained that the amendments were unconstitutional; the ruling allowed payment outside the cap.

decisoes.processo: ADI sobre o decreto do IOF de 2025
decisoes.o_que_decidiu: Justice Alexandre de Moraes, ruling single-handedly after a failed conciliation hearing between the government and Congress, upheld the validity of most of the presidential decree that raised IOF rates on credit, foreign exchange and insurance transactions, setting aside only the charge on 'risco sacado' transactions.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The presidential decree that raised the IOF was upheld almost in its entirety.

decisoes.processo: Ações sobre a Lei 14.701/2023 (marco temporal de terras indígenas)
decisoes.o_que_decidiu: The STF ruled the marco temporal thesis unconstitutional, invalidating the requirement that indigenous peoples prove occupation of the land on October 5, 1988 for demarcation purposes. Lei 14.701/2023, which had incorporated that thesis, was passed by Congress overriding a partial veto by President Lula.
decisoes.efeito_porque: The law struck down had been passed by Congress overriding a partial presidential veto: the government lost the law Congress had imposed on it and had its veto, in part, upheld by the court.

caso_123.o_que_e: A compilation of 123 decisions/rulings by the Supremo Tribunal Federal involving the federal government between 2019 and August 2021. According to CNN Brasil, a compilation of this kind was reviewed, in the week of August 23 to 27, 2021, by active-duty and reserve military officers and by civilian members of the government at the Palácio do Planalto. In those same days, the digital newspaper Correio da Manhã published a list of its own, also with 123 items, under the title 'As 123 manifestações do STF na relação com o governo federal' (25/08/2021), widely reproduced by other outlets (Revista Oeste, DefesaNet/Task Force Brazil column, among others). The sources consulted do not make it possible to identify a single, certain institutional authorship: CNN Brasil attributes the compilation used at the Planalto to military and pro-government circles, on the basis of 'newspaper and magazine reports since 2019'; no indication was found that the compilation was produced by the STF, by the AGU or by any official body.
caso_123.o_que_contava: According to CNN Brasil and Correio da Manhã, the list brings together decisions of various kinds - injunctions (including suspending provisional measures, decrees and resolutions of the government), orders setting deadlines for the government to provide explanations, and the opening of investigations involving the president and ministers - taken by justices of the STF (with Alexandre de Moraes cited as the most frequent, followed by Ricardo Lewandowski, Luís Roberto Barroso, Cármen Lúcia and Rosa Weber) between 2019 and 2021, on topics such as Covid-19, firearms, indigenous lands, vaccines, education, freedom of expression, the Armed Forces and intelligence activities. It is not an official court document of the STF, but a journalistic/political compilation put together from news reports already published.
caso_123.o_que_procurei: Targeted searches for 'levantamento decisões STF contra governo Lula/Dilma/Temer/FHC número total contagem semelhante a 123', for terms such as 'taxa de sucesso da União no STF' and for variations of the document's name returned no equivalent numerical compilation (a consolidated count of STF decisions/rulings in relation to the federal government) publicly released or reported for the FHC, Lula I/II (2003-2010), Dilma, Temer or Lula III (2023-2026) administrations. What exists for other periods is only statistics of a different nature (e.g.: number of ADIs judged in the year, the AGU's legal success rate on specific topics) - not a count of STF decisions 'against' or 'about' a particular administration such as the one that circulated in 2021.

fontes.nome: CNN Brasil - 'Palácio analisa documento que lista decisões do STF no governo Bolsonaro'
Correio da Manhã (Brasil) - 'As 123 manifestações do STF na relação com o governo federal'
fontes.orientacao: imprensa digital de menor porte; orientação editorial não claramente identificada nesta pesquisa

fontes.nome: DefesaNet / coluna Task Force Brazil (TFBR) - 'As 123 Manifestações do STF na relação com o Governo Federal'
fontes.orientacao: imprensa especializada em defesa, com coluna de opinião de fontes ligadas a militares; leitura próxima da narrativa das Forças Armadas

fontes.nome: Revista Oeste - 'STF já tomou 123 medidas contra Bolsonaro, mostra levantamento'

notas: The selection of decisions is editorial: these are far-reaching cases, not a census of everything the STF has ruled involving the federal government. An administration appearing with more items reflects this selection and the available coverage, not a measure of friction.
Each ruling is filed under the administration in office on the date of the judgment, which is not always the administration that issued the challenged act.
For the 1998-2002 period it was only possible to confirm two decisions in a legible source — the STF's own domains block automated reading, which limited access to the oldest primary sources.
The statistics above are isolated points, from different years and different universes. They do not form a series and are not comparable with one another.
stf.criterio_efeito: Each decision was classified by ONE question: did the argument or the act defended by the federal government in office on the date of the ruling prevail? If so, 'favorable'. If not, 'against'. When there was no federal Executive act or argument in dispute, or when the decision partly satisfied both sides, the item is left as 'undetermined' — and it is not forced onto either side. The classification is an editorial choice of this site, not a datum from the court, and each item states why it received the label it received.

pendentes.processos: ADI 6399, ADI 6403 and ADI 6415 (against the 2020 rule); ADI 7347 and ADI 7353 (against Provisional Measure 1.160/2023); ADI 7548 (against Law 14.689/2023)
pendentes.autores: The Prosecutor General's Office, PSB and ANFIP in the first block; the Federal Council of the OAB, Progressistas and Republicanos in the second; Partido Novo in the third
pendentes.relator: Marco Aurélio in the first block, retired in 2021; Dias Toffoli in the second; Edson Fachin in the third
pendentes.situacao: No final ruling on the merits as of September 2026. The cases against the 2020 rule were scheduled for 26 August 2026 and were removed from the docket five days earlier, with no new date.
pendentes.por_que_esta_aqui: It circulated as though the Supreme Court had already upheld the return of the casting vote. It has not: what happened were rulings in individual cases, which do not decide the constitutionality of the rule. A pending case does not enter the count of rulings above, because it is not a ruling — but leaving it out entirely would also be an omission, since the matter spans three governments and is among the largest sums in dispute at the court.
pendentes.ressalva_fonte: The Supreme Court's domains block automated reading, so the progress of these cases could not be checked at the primary source by this collection: the information came from secondary sources (OAB, ANFIP and specialist press). The laws cited, by contrast, are verified at the Planalto and at the National Congress.

stf.pendentes_intro: The list above is of rulings. Not everything the court receives becomes a ruling, and some of the furthest-reaching cases go years without judgment — which in practice also has an effect, because it keeps the existing rule in force meanwhile. What follows enters no count on this page, precisely because it has not been judged.

marcos.o_que: The Comitê Executivo de Governo Eletrônico was created within the structure of the Conselho de Governo, tasked with formulating policies, setting guidelines and coordinating the actions to implement electronic government aimed at providing services to citizens.
marcos.ato: Decreto of October 18, 2000 (unnumbered decree)
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pelo presidente Fernando Henrique Cardoso e pelos ministros Martus Tavares e Pedro Parente.

marcos.o_que: The Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil) was created, a digital certification system intended to guarantee the authenticity, integrity and legal validity of documents in electronic form and of the supporting applications that use digital certificates.
marcos.ato: Medida Provisória nº 2.200-2, of August 24, 2001 (a reissue of MP nº 2.200, of June 28, 2001; under Emenda Constitucional nº 32/2001, provisional measures issued up to 11/9/2001 and not voted on by Congress remain in force until a final decision, which keeps MP 2.200-2 in force without conversion into law)
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo, editado diretamente pelo presidente Fernando Henrique Cardoso, sem tramitação de projeto de lei no Congresso (medida provisória).

marcos.o_que: The Programa Universidade para Todos (ProUni) was established, providing full and partial scholarships at private higher education institutions.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 11.096, of January 13, 2005 (conversion of Medida Provisória nº 213, of September 10, 2004)
marcos.autoria: Medida Provisória editada pelo Poder Executivo (presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva) e depois convertida em lei pelo Congresso Nacional; sanção do presidente Lula, com os ministros Antonio Palocci Filho (Fazenda) e Tarso Genro (Educação).

marcos.o_que: The Portal da Transparência of the Federal Executive Branch was established, intended to carry detailed data and information on the Union's budgetary and financial execution, and an obligation was created for federal bodies to maintain a Transparência Pública page on their respective websites.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 5.482, of June 30, 2005 (repealed by Decreto nº 11.529/2023, which gave new treatment to federal proactive transparency)
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e pelo ministro-chefe da Controladoria-Geral da União, Waldir Pires. A Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) afirma, em página institucional própria, que o Portal já existia desde 2004 como iniciativa da CGU; este decreto, de 2005, é o ato normativo que o formaliza e lhe dá caráter obrigatório.

marcos.o_que: The creation of a free telephone line for women in situations of violence was authorized, later implemented as the Central de Atendimento à Mulher – Ligue 180.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 10.714, of August 13, 2003
marcos.autoria: Lei que autorizou a criação da linha; segundo o Portal da Câmara dos Deputados, a implementação efetiva do serviço pelo governo federal, sob a então Secretaria Especial de Políticas para as Mulheres, ocorreu em 2005. Não confirmamos, em fonte lida, o nome do autor do projeto de lei original nem o ministro que referendou a sanção.

marcos.o_que: The status of Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) was created, with a simplified regime for formalization, taxation and payment of contributions for individuals who carry on business activity on their own account.
marcos.ato: Lei Complementar nº 128, of December 19, 2008
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei Complementar nº 2/2007, apresentado na Câmara dos Deputados pelo deputado Antonio Carlos Mendes Thame (PSDB-SP) em 6 de fevereiro de 2007, tramitado no Senado como Projeto de Lei da Câmara nº 128/2008; sanção do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

marcos.o_que: The Sistema de Seleção Unificada (Sisu) was created, for the selection of candidates for undergraduate places at participating public higher education institutions, based on the Enem score.
marcos.ato: Portaria Normativa MEC nº 2, of January 26, 2010
marcos.autoria: Ato do Ministério da Educação, sob a gestão do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

marcos.nome: Lei de Acesso à Informação (LAI) e regulamentação federal (e-SIC)
marcos.o_que: The Lei de Acesso à Informação was established, regulating the right of access to public information; its regulation at the federal level, in 2012, created the Serviço de Informações ao Cidadão (SIC) and the e-SIC electronic system for information access requests.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 12.527, of November 18, 2011; regulated, at the federal level, by Decreto nº 7.724, of May 16, 2012
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei nº 219/2003, apresentado na Câmara dos Deputados pelo deputado Reginaldo Lopes (PT-MG) em 26/2/2003, com tramitação de quase nove anos até a sanção; lei sancionada pela presidenta Dilma Rousseff em 2011, em vigor a partir de 16/5/2012. O decreto regulamentador federal de 2012, que criou o e-SIC, também foi assinado por Dilma Rousseff, com o ministro da Justiça José Eduardo Cardozo.

marcos.o_que: The Marco Civil da Internet was enacted, a law that establishes principles, guarantees, rights and duties for the use of the internet in Brazil, including net neutrality and protection of users' privacy.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 12.965, of April 23, 2014
marcos.autoria: Anteprojeto elaborado pela Secretaria de Assuntos Legislativos do Ministério da Justiça a partir de consulta pública pela internet iniciada em 2009; enviado pela presidenta Dilma Rousseff à Câmara dos Deputados em 24/8/2011 como Projeto de Lei nº 2.126/2011, com pedido de urgência; sancionado pela presidenta Dilma Rousseff em 23/4/2014, em cerimônia durante o encontro NETmundial, em São Paulo.

marcos.o_que: The Política de Governança Digital was established for the bodies of the direct federal public administration, autarchies and foundations, with the aim of generating benefits for society through the use of information and technology resources, and of increasing transparency and social participation.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 8.638, of January 15, 2016 (repealed by Decreto nº 10.332/2020)
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pela presidenta Dilma Rousseff e pelo ministro Valdir Moysés Simão.

marcos.o_que: The Plataforma de Cidadania Digital was created, intended to allow individuals and legal entities to request and track the provision of public services without the need to appear in person; the platform was later renamed Plataforma gov.br.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 8.936, of December 19, 2016
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pelo presidente Michel Temer e pelos ministros Dyogo Henrique de Oliveira e Torquato Jardim. O decreto é de dezembro de 2016, portanto já sob a gestão de Michel Temer (que assumiu definitivamente a Presidência em 31/8/2016, após o impeachment de Dilma Rousseff), e não da gestão anterior.

marcos.nome: CNH Digital (CNH Eletrônica / Carteira Digital de Trânsito)
marcos.o_que: The Carteira Nacional de Habilitação in electronic form (CNH-e) was created, to be issued as established by the Departamento Nacional de Trânsito, giving rise to the Carteira Digital de Trânsito app.
marcos.ato: Resolução Contran nº 684, of July 25, 2017
marcos.autoria: Ato do Conselho Nacional de Trânsito (Contran), colegiado vinculado ao Ministério dos Transportes, Portos e Aviação Civil; assinada pelo presidente do Contran, Elmer Coelho Vicenzi, e por representantes de diversos ministérios, sob a gestão do presidente Michel Temer.

marcos.nome: e-Título (aplicativo do título de eleitor digital)
marcos.o_que: The Tribunal Superior Eleitoral launched the e-Título app, which provides a digital copy of the voter registration card and allows voters to vote with the document on a phone or tablet.
marcos.ato: Institutional administrative act of the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (launch announced in an official TSE news item on 1º/12/2017); we did not find, in any source read within the timeframe of this research, a numbered TSE resolution specifically creating the app.
marcos.autoria: Iniciativa da Justiça Eleitoral (TSE), presidida à época pelo ministro Gilmar Mendes, sem vínculo com o Poder Executivo federal.

marcos.nome: LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais)
marcos.o_que: The Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais was enacted, governing the processing of personal data by natural persons and legal entities, whether public or private.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 13.709, of August 14, 2018
marcos.autoria: Origem em pelo menos dois projetos: o Projeto de Lei nº 4.060/2012, apresentado na Câmara pelo deputado Milton Monti (PR-SP) em junho de 2012, a partir de discussões do V Congresso Brasileiro de Direito da Informática; e o Projeto de Lei nº 5.276/2016, enviado ao Congresso com pedido de urgência pela presidenta Dilma Rousseff em maio de 2016 (urgência depois retirada pelo presidente interino Michel Temer). O texto aprovado no Senado como Projeto de Lei da Câmara nº 53/2018 foi sancionado pelo presidente Michel Temer em 14/8/2018.

marcos.o_que: The single gov.br portal was created, unifying the federal government's digital channels for the centralized provision of institutional information, news and public services.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 9.756, of April 11, 2019
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro e pelos ministros Marcelo Pacheco dos Guaranys, Mauro Biancamano Guimarães e Floriano Peixoto Vieira Neto. O decreto deu novo nome e nova base normativa à Plataforma de Cidadania Digital, criada em 2016 no governo Temer, unificando-a com os demais sítios federais sob o domínio gov.br.

marcos.o_que: The Carteira de Trabalho Digital was created, with validity equivalent to that of the physical card for labor purposes; issuance in electronic format was then governed by a specific ordinance.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 13.874, of September 20, 2019 (Lei da Liberdade Econômica); issuance governed by Portaria SEPRT nº 1.065, of September 23, 2019
marcos.autoria: Lei sancionada pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro; a Portaria nº 1.065/2019, que disciplinou a emissão em meio eletrônico, foi assinada por Rogério Marinho, Secretário Especial de Previdência e Trabalho do Ministério da Economia. A própria Instrução Normativa PRES/INSS nº 128/2022 (art. 40) confirma que 'a Carteira de Trabalho Digital foi instituída pela Lei nº 13.874, de 2019'.

marcos.o_que: The Pix instant payment arrangement was established and its regulation approved; transactions between users began to be processed from November 2020 onward.
marcos.ato: Resolução BCB nº 1, of August 12, 2020
marcos.autoria: Ato próprio do Banco Central do Brasil, autarquia federal responsável por conduzir e regulamentar o Pix desde sua concepção. À época da instituição do Pix (2020), o Banco Central ainda não tinha autonomia formal — esta só foi estabelecida pela Lei Complementar nº 179, de 24 de fevereiro de 2021, sancionada pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que caracterizou o Banco Central como autarquia especial com autonomia técnica, operacional, administrativa e financeira, e definiu regras de mandato fixo para sua diretoria.

marcos.o_que: The ConecteSUS app, which already existed as the citizen's digital health record in the SUS (previously called Meu digiSUS), began to make the Covid-19 vaccination certificate available, allowing vaccination to be proven by cell phone.
marcos.ato: We did not find, in any source read, a numbered decree or ordinance specifically creating this ConecteSUS function; the record is institutional publicity from the Ministério da Saúde/UNA-SUS (a body linked to Fiocruz/Ministério da Saúde), with no normative act cited.
marcos.autoria: Iniciativa do Ministério da Saúde, sob a gestão do presidente Jair Bolsonaro, no contexto do Plano Nacional de Operacionalização da Vacinação contra a Covid-19.

marcos.o_que: Principles, rules and instruments were established for Digital Government and for increasing public efficiency, including cutting red tape and providing public services by digital means, including through mobile devices.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.129, of March 29, 2021
marcos.autoria: Sanção do presidente Jair Bolsonaro, com os ministros André Luiz de Almeida Mendonça, Paulo Guedes, Marcos César Pontes, Wagner de Campos Rosário e Onyx Lorenzoni.

marcos.nome: Prova de vida do INSS por biometria
marcos.o_que: The system for the annual proof-of-life check of INSS beneficiaries was changed, now preferably allowing the use of biometrics, completion by a representative and home visits for people over 80 or with difficulty getting around.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.199, of September 2, 2021
marcos.autoria: Projeto aprovado pela Câmara dos Deputados em julho de 2021, com relatoria do deputado Danilo Cabral (PSB-PE); sanção do presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que vetou o dispositivo que suspenderia por completo a exigência de prova de vida até 31/12/2021.

marcos.nome: Regulamentação da prova de vida do INSS por cruzamento de dados (base normativa)
marcos.o_que: The acts, means and databases that would come to count as proof of life for INSS beneficiaries were defined (vaccination, voting, document issuance, SUS care, among others), opening the way for the proactive proof of life by data cross-referencing that the agency would begin to carry out from 2023.
marcos.ato: Portaria PRES/INSS nº 1.408, of February 2, 2022
marcos.autoria: Ato próprio do INSS, sob a gestão do presidente Jair Bolsonaro; a operacionalização proativa desse cruzamento de dados só passou a valer a partir de 2023, já no governo seguinte (ver marco de 2023).

marcos.o_que: Procedures were regulated for the issuing of the Carteira de Identidade by the identification bodies of the states and of the Distrito Federal, based on a single Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas (CPF) number, establishing the Serviço de Identificação do Cidadão as the national civil identification system.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 10.977, of February 23, 2022
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo; assinado pelo presidente Jair Bolsonaro e pelos ministros Anderson Gustavo Torres, Paulo Guedes e Luiz Eduardo Ramos Baptista Pereira. A emissão da CIN nos estados foi ampliada gradualmente ao longo de 2022 e nos anos seguintes, já sob a gestão seguinte, conforme a adesão de cada órgão estadual de identificação.

marcos.nome: Prova de vida automática do INSS por cruzamento de dados
marcos.o_que: The INSS began to carry out proof of life for beneficiaries proactively, by cross-referencing information between public databases (vaccination, voting, SUS care, document issuance, among others), removing the need to appear in person at banks or offices for anyone who already has a sufficient 'package of information'.
marcos.ato: Portaria PRES/INSS nº 1.408, of February 2, 2022, amended and detailed by Portarias PRES/INSS nº 1.552 and nº 1.103, both of January 2023
marcos.autoria: A base normativa (Portaria 1.408/2022) foi editada ainda no governo Jair Bolsonaro; a operacionalização proativa do cruzamento de dados, efetivamente iniciada em 2023 e detalhada pelas portarias de janeiro de 2023, ocorreu já sob a gestão do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, em parceria entre INSS e Dataprev (empresa pública federal).

marcos.o_que: The Programa Emergencial de Renegociação de Dívidas de Pessoas Físicas Inadimplentes (Desenrola Brasil) was created, intended to encourage the renegotiation of debts of individuals listed in default registries, with guarantees and tax incentives for participating financial institutions.
marcos.ato: Lei nº 14.690, of October 3, 2023 (conversion of Medida Provisória nº 1.176, of June 5, 2023)
marcos.autoria: Medida provisória editada pelo Poder Executivo e depois convertida em lei pelo Congresso Nacional; sanção do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, com o ministro Fernando Haddad (Fazenda).

marcos.o_que: The Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública, in partnership with Anatel, Febraban, financial institutions and telephone operators, made available the Celular Seguro app, which allows a victim of robbery or theft to block the device, the phone line (SIM card) and the banking apps installed on it.
marcos.ato: No numbered decree or ordinance formally establishing the Programa Celular Seguro at the moment of creation was located in any source read; the official Anatel page about the app, used as a source, was published on March 5, 2024. Press reports not confirmed by an official source place an initial launch in December 2023, with an expanded version — including the Banco Nacional de Celulares com Restrição (BNCR) — relaunched in December 2024.
marcos.autoria: Iniciativa do Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública, sob a gestão do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, em parceria com a Anatel (autarquia) e entidades privadas (Febraban, instituições financeiras e operadoras).

marcos.o_que: The Estratégia Nacional de Governo Digital and the Rede Nacional de Governo Digital (Rede Gov.br) were created for the period 2024 to 2027, setting guidelines and targets for the digital transformation of the federal public administration.
marcos.ato: Decreto nº 12.069, of June 21, 2024
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo, sob a gestão do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

marcos.o_que: The sharing of the payment transaction initiation service without the need for redirection between systems was regulated, making contactless Pix possible (payment by NFC technology from digital wallets, without having to open the bank's app).
marcos.ato: Resolução BCB nº 406, of August 2, 2024
marcos.autoria: Ato próprio do Banco Central do Brasil, autarquia com autonomia formal desde a Lei Complementar nº 179/2021. Reportagens de imprensa, não confirmadas em página oficial lida nesta pesquisa, situam o início efetivo do funcionamento do Pix por aproximação para o público em 28 de fevereiro de 2025.

series_nao_encontradas.o_que: Number of federal public services digitized, by year
series_nao_encontradas.por_que: The Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos maintains a Painel de Serviços (painel.servicos.gov.br) and 'Serviços Digitais' pages by year (2022, 2023) within Governo Digital, but, during this data collection (September 2026), the news pages and the digital services listings on the gov.br domain (gov.br/gestao, gov.br/governodigital) systematically returned 'Restricted Content' (requiring authentication), and the interactive dashboard depends on JavaScript loading that could not be read by the tools of this research. It was therefore not possible to assemble a reliable, comparable annual series from an official source read directly.

series_nao_encontradas.o_que: Number of accounts or users of the gov.br platform, by year
series_nao_encontradas.por_que: There are isolated official announcements released by the Ministério da Gestão and by news reports that reproduce them (for example, 155 million users in December 2023 and 175 million in March 2026), but the official news pages on gov.br (gov.br/gestao, gov.br/governodigital) returned 'Restricted Content' during this data collection, and the pages of Agência Gov (agenciagov.ebc.com.br), which replicate those announcements, were 'temporarily deactivated in compliance with the electoral legislation in force'. Without access to the primary official pages, it was not possible to assemble a complete and verified annual series; the isolated figures cited above do not, by themselves, form a year-by-year series.

series_nao_encontradas.o_que: Meu INSS app — launch date and establishing act
series_nao_encontradas.por_que: Sources diverge on the year of creation (2016, according to a publication by the International Social Security Association citing the INSS; 2017, according to various press reports), and no exact date or numbered decree/ordinance establishing the app was located in any official INSS page, or page of the then Ministério da Previdência/Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social, read in this research — the relevant news pages on the gov.br domain returned 'Conteúdo Restrito' during this collection. For that reason, Meu INSS did not enter as a dated milestone in the file.

series_nao_encontradas.o_que: Disque 100 (Disque Direitos Humanos) — creation date and the act establishing it as a federal service
series_nao_encontradas.por_que: The origin of the number goes back to an 0800 hotline for reporting child sexual abuse operated by the NGO Abrapia since 1997, under an agreement with the Ministério da Justiça; the number '100' was only granted by Anatel in 2006; and the Coordenação-Geral do Disque Direitos Humanos, linked to the Ouvidoria Nacional de Direitos Humanos, was only formalized by Decreto nº 6.980/2009 (amended by Decreto nº 7.256/2010) — already outside the 2003-2005 period given as the initial reference. Given this overlap of dates and acts, without a single official source clearly tying 'Disque 100, created in 2003 or 2005' to an act with a number, the item did not enter as a standalone milestone in this file.

series_nao_encontradas.o_que: Filing of the Imposto de Renda return over the internet (Receitanet)
series_nao_encontradas.por_que: The Receita Federal itself confirms, on an official page (gov.br/receitafederal), that the Receitanet program was launched in March 1997, allowing tax returns to be filed over the internet — but that page does not cite the number of the normative instruction or other specific act that established it, and we did not find that number in another official source within the time frame of this research. For that reason, although the date and the fact are confirmed, the item did not enter as a milestone because it lacks the act identified by number required by the rules of this data collection.

notas: Data collected in September 2026. Several 'news' pages on gov.br domains (for example, gov.br/gestao, gov.br/governodigital, gov.br/previdencia, gov.br/secom, gov.br/inss) returned 'Restricted Content — authentication required' over the course of this research, even for apparently public content; and the pages of Agência Gov (agenciagov.ebc.com.br) were explicitly deactivated 'in compliance with the electoral legislation in force'. This limited the confirmation of some recent milestones and prevented the assembly of two indicator series (see 'series_nao_encontradas'). Whenever a piece of information depends on one of these pages, that is recorded in the item itself.

The Banco Central do Brasil had been testing, since March 2023, a pilot of a central bank digital currency named Drex (previously called 'Real Digital'). Several press reports from November 2025 (not confirmed in any official Banco Central statement read in this research) said that the Banco Central had ended that blockchain-based pilot, redirecting the project toward an approach without that technology. Because we did not find an official BCB statement confirming that termination, Drex did not enter as a milestone in the main file; we record here the divergence between what the press reported and what we were able to confirm in an official source.

Three authorship caveats, checked item by item: (1) Pix is run by the Banco Central, an agency that only gained formal autonomy through Lei Complementar 179/2021 — about three months after Pix was already in operation, in November 2020; this is recorded in the authorship field of the Pix milestone. (2) LAI, Marco Civil and LGPD originated in bills introduced years before they were signed into law (2003, 2009/2011/2012 and 2012/2016, respectively) — the years of introduction and of signing are recorded in the authorship field of each milestone. (3) gov.br and the CIN span more than one administration, and the date used here is that of the act that created each one, not the end of rollout.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 12.965, de 23 de abril de 2014
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes principles, guarantees, rights and duties for the use of the internet in Brazil, including net neutrality, protection of privacy and of the secrecy of communications and civil liability rules for connection and application providers.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 2126/2011, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Dilma Rousseff.

expressao.por: Before the law there was no federal rule on who orders content taken down. Art. 19 established that, outside the exceptions, an application provider is liable in civil law only if it disobeys a court order — that is, it moved the take-down decision to a judge, with a duty to notify the user (art. 20) and a procedure of its own for non-consensual nudity (art. 21). This is a redesign: the previous arrangement was case-by-case case law. Art. 19 itself was ruled on by the Supreme Court in 2025 and the Court changed the rule, which is recorded in the Judiciary infographic.
