seguranca_juridica.por: It created deadlines, powers and procedure where there was a void: log retention for a set period, disclosure only on a court order, and civil liability under a written rule. It changes the rule across the sector, but it replaces no previous regime, because there was no previous regime — hence 2 and not 3.

concorrencia.por: Net neutrality bars a connection provider from degrading or favouring traffic by content, origin or application. That changes the barrier to entry for anyone offering an application: without the rule, the owner of the network could charge for a competitor's service to work at all. It applies across the sector.

acesso.por: The act treats internet access as an objective and bars traffic discrimination, which affects the quality of what reaches the user, but it sets no price, no tariff, no coverage target and no enforceable quality standard. It only grazes the dimension.

investimento.por: Neutrality's effect on network investment is disputed: carriers argue it reduces the incentive to invest, and application providers argue the opposite. The text creates no contract, auction, guarantee or incentive — hence a reach of 1, and the sign is left open because the disagreement is real and no series settles it.

fiscal.por: The act creates no revenue, spending, tax break, subsidy or federal guarantee.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.709, de 14 de agosto de 2018
marcos.nome: LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law addresses the processing of personal data by natural persons or legal entities governed by public or private law, defining the grounds that authorize processing, the rights of data subjects and the duties of controllers and processors.
marcos.autoria: Origem no Congresso Nacional, no PLC 53/2018 do Senado (unificação do PL 4060/2012, da Câmara, com o PLS 330/2013, do Senado); sancionada com vetos por Michel Temer (fato corroborado por cobertura jornalística da época, já que o trecho final de assinatura não foi recuperável no texto do Planalto durante esta coleta).

seguranca_juridica.por: Creates from nothing the liability regime for the processing of personal data: it applies to a company based abroad when the data is collected here, closes the list of grounds for international transfer, sets out the liability of the controller and the processor, and creates a scale of penalties decided by a national authority. There was no general law before, and it is the existence of that new decision-maker that makes this a redesign rather than an adjustment.

expressao.por: Puts freedom of expression among the foundations of the regime and takes out of the law's reach any processing for exclusively journalistic and artistic purposes. It is a rule about personal data, and that carve-out was written precisely so that it would not become a rule about content.

concorrencia.por: The penalties include partial or total suspension of the operation of the database and a ban on carrying out processing activity — the power to remove a firm from the market. The law creates no licence, no prior authorisation and no capital requirement.

acesso.por: The data subject's request is met at no cost to them, in a simplified format, and a security incident carrying significant risk must be reported to the data subject. These are enforceable service standards, without touching price, coverage or continuity.

fiscal.por: A fine of up to 2% of turnover, capped at R$ 50 million per infringement, with the proceeds assigned to the Fundo de Defesa de Direitos Difusos (Diffuse Rights Defence Fund). This is penalty revenue, not a fiscal rule.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, concessions, guarantees or research incentives.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei Complementar nº 182, de 1º de junho de 2021
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes the legal framework for startups and innovative entrepreneurship, defines the classification of companies as startups, creates investment instruments such as the option contract to purchase an equity stake, and authorizes a regulatory sandbox and the public procurement of innovative solutions.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PLP 249/2020, apresentado pelo Ministério da Economia, conforme noticiado pelo Congresso e pela imprensa especializada no momento do envio); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Jair Bolsonaro.

concorrencia.por: Allows the sector regulator to set aside, by a regulation of its own, rules under its competence in order to test new solutions; creates a special tender in which the notice may state only the problem to be solved; and waives a fresh tender for the subsequent supply.

investimento.por: Lists seven investment instruments that do not form part of share capital, states that the investor is not a partner and is not liable for the company's debt, not even in judicial reorganisation, and allows the research and development obligation to be met through endowment funds and private equity funds.

seguranca_juridica.por: Defines angel investor and experimental regulatory environment in statute, delimits the liability of those who invest, gives regulatory competence to the CVM (the securities regulator) and to the sector regulators and comes into force 90 days after publication.

fiscal.por: Sets a ceiling of R$ 1.6 million per public contract for an innovative solution and limits subsequent supply to five times that amount. It is a spending cap, not the creation of revenue or a tax break.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or the standard of service to the user.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.852, de 3 de maio de 2024
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law waives prior state authorization for the manufacture, import, sale, development and commercial use of electronic games and sets rules on age rating, protection of children and adolescents and tax incentives for the sector.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa parlamentar (PL 2796/2021, autor: deputado Kim Kataguiri, DEM/SP, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

concorrencia.por: Declares the manufacture, import, sale, development and commercial use of games to be free and expressly waives prior state authorisation, leaving the State only with indicative age rating. It changes the sector's entry rule without replacing an earlier licensing regime, which did not exist.

expressao.por: Swaps prior authorisation for advisory age rating and, in return, creates design duties towards children, a complaints and reporting channel, parental tools and a default restriction on purchases by minors. It widens what may be published and moves moderation to the platform itself.

investimento.por: Classifies game development as investment in research, development, innovation and culture, includes the sector among the beneficiaries of the Lei Rouanet (the cultural incentive law) and provides for public support for workforce training.

fiscal.por: Opens to the sector the existing incentive mechanisms for audiovisual and culture, and orders customs clearance and import duties on development tools to be regulated. The tax break comes from that classification; it is not created here.

seguranca_juridica.por: Defines what an electronic game is and expressly separates it from betting and from prediction games. It only just scrapes in because the text provides neither a penalty nor a supervisory body for the duties it itself creates, and part of it depends on regulation.

acesso.por: In-game purchase tools must restrict purchases by children and adolescents by default, with the consent of the person responsible for them. It is an enforceable standard towards the user, without touching price.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 11.445, de 5 de janeiro de 2007
marcos.nome: Marco Legal do Saneamento Básico (lei original)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes the national guidelines for basic sanitation, defining the set of services for water supply, sewage, urban cleaning, solid waste management and rainwater drainage, and the conditions for the provision of those services.
marcos.autoria: Sancionada por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva; origem do projeto não confirmada nesta coleta (o texto do Planalto acessado não identifica o número do projeto de lei nem seu autor).

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.026, de 15 de julho de 2020
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law updates the legal framework for basic sanitation, gives the federal regulatory agency (ANA, today ANA-Saneamento) the power to establish national reference standards for the regulation of the services and sets universal-coverage targets of 99% for drinking water and 90% for sewage collection and treatment by 2033.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei nº 4.162, de 2019, de iniciativa do Poder Executivo (Mensagem nº 320/2019); relatoria de Geninho Zuliani (DEM-SP) na Câmara e do senador Tasso Jereissati (PSDB-CE) no Senado. Aprovado na Câmara em 17/12/2019 e no Senado em 24/06/2020; sancionado com vetos por Jair Bolsonaro, e os vetos foram mantidos pelo Congresso em 17/03/2021. Correção: este site dizia antes que a lei nascera do PL 3261/2019, de autoria do senador Tasso Jereissati — aquele projeto existe, mas foi arquivado na Câmara em 17/12/2019 justamente porque o PL 4.162/2019 foi aprovado em seu lugar. Tasso Jereissati entra nesta lei como relator no Senado, não como autor, e a iniciativa é do Executivo, não do Senado. A Medida Provisória 868/2018, sobre o mesmo tema, havia perdido a validade sem votação. Fonte: https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/fichadetramitacao?idProposicao=2213200

concorrencia.por: It ended the 'programme contract', which let a municipality hand the service to the state-owned company with no tender, and required instead a concession contract preceded by a tender. This swaps the entire arrangement for who may run sanitation in the country, rather than adjusting a rule.

acesso.por: It wrote national universal-service targets into law — 99% for drinking water and 90% for sewage collection and treatment by 31/12/2033 — with a deadline and a contractual obligation. Before, the targets sat in a plan, not in a statute. The sign records that the rule expands access; whether the targets were met is a different question, and the answer depends on a series that does not yet cover the full period.

investimento.por: It created a requirement to demonstrate economic and financial capacity to provide the service, introduced regionalised provision, and made federal support conditional on joining the new regime — that is, it reorganised how sanitation investment is contracted and funded.

seguranca_juridica.por: It gave the federal water agency the power to issue national reference standards, which had not existed, and set a transition for contracts in force. It changes the rule across the sector. The sign is left open because the division of powers between the federal government, the states and the municipalities was itself taken to the Supreme Court in ADIs 6,492, 6,536, 6,583 and 6,882, dismissed in 2021 as to most of the text — which confirmed the law, but after two years of uncertainty over contracts already running.

fiscal.disp: arts. 13 and 50 of Law 11,445 as amended
fiscal.por: It made access to federal public funds conditional on joining regionalised provision and meeting the new requirements, which redirects federal spending and guarantees without, in itself, raising or lowering the total.

expressao.por: The act does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.273, de 23 de dezembro de 2021
marcos.nome: Marco Legal das Ferrovias (Nova Lei das Ferrovias)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law sets the legal regime for granting the exploitation of railway infrastructure, creating authorization arrangements (direct and indirect grants) in addition to concession, and amends other laws on expropriation, public registries and transport.
marcos.autoria: Aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionada com vetos por Jair Bolsonaro; a autoria específica do projeto de lei de origem não foi confirmada com precisão nesta coleta.

concorrencia.por: Creates the railway authorisation regime: anyone wishing to operate applies at any time and receives a standard contract, with a public call and a selection where there is more than one interested party, alongside the concession regime. It swaps the sector's front door.

investimento.por: An authorisation contract of 25 to 99 years, assets that do not revert to the state, user investment in capacity freely negotiated, return of a stretch with no traffic for four years against compensation, and, where a new law cuts the grant short, enough time to amortise.

acesso.por: A tariff cap under the public regime, free pricing for ancillary services with abusive pricing barred, free travel only under a law that identifies the funds and with reimbursement within 90 days, a ban on unjustified refusal of cargo, and a compulsory ombudsman's office.

fiscal.por: Non-tax amounts the federal government receives from railway operators must be reinvested in infrastructure, and at least half of what comes from grants and compensation goes to state projects. It redirects revenue without creating any or giving any up.

seguranca_juridica.por: Closes the grounds for terminating the authorisation into a list and defines each one — lapse, forfeiture, waiver, annulment —, gives the regulator competence over safety and allows an existing concession to migrate to the new regime.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.301, de 7 de janeiro de 2022
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law creates the Programa de Estímulo ao Transporte por Cabotagem (BR do Mar), with rules to expand the supply of vessels and competition among cabotage shipping operators in Brazil.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 4199/2020, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Jair Bolsonaro.

concorrencia.por: Creates a specific qualification for a Brazilian shipping company that widens the chartering of foreign vessels, including from a wholly owned subsidiary, with its own requirements, deadlines and quantities. It changes the rule of access to cabotage within the framework of the 1997 law, which remains in force.

fiscal.por: Chartered vessels enter under temporary admission with full suspension of import duty, IPI, PIS/Pasep, Cofins, Cide and the AFRMM (merchant marine freight charge), and the law sets the AFRMM at 8% in coastal shipping, channelled to the Fundo Naval.

investimento.por: Makes it compulsory to offer shipboard traineeships, channels funds into earmarked accounts for building, upgrading and repair, and sets among its objectives the training of Brazilian seafarers and the coastal shipping shipbuilding industry.

seguranca_juridica.por: Writes regulatory stability into the guiding principles, limits what regulation may demand of the company to the provision of information, provides for loss of the qualification with a two-year waiting period, gives changes effect only for the future and sets 90 days for ANTAQ (the waterway transport regulator) to define criteria.

acesso.por: Sets as objectives widening supply and improving the quality of coastal shipping, and requires periodic inspections and insurance cover, without fixing freight rates, adjustments or a coverage target.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.134, de 8 de abril de 2021
marcos.nome: Marco Legal do Gás Natural (Nova Lei do Gás)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes that the transport of natural gas, including construction, expansion, operation and maintenance of the facilities, will be carried out under an authorization regime regulated and supervised by the ANP, and also governs the import, export, storage, processing and marketing of natural gas.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa parlamentar (PL 4476/2020, anteriormente PL 6407/2013, autor: deputado Antonio Carlos Mendes Thame, PSDB/SP, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado sem vetos por Jair Bolsonaro.

concorrencia.por: Repeals the previous gas law and swaps concession for authorisation in transport, with a prior public call, a selection procedure where there are several interested parties, certification of the carrier's independence, and a ban on a competing player influencing the running of the state distribution company.

investimento.por: A public call to build and expand pipelines, capacity contracted by entry and exit points, authorisation for underground storage, and minimum contract content defined by the ANP, with standardised contracts in an organised market.

acesso.por: The ANP now sets the maximum allowed transport revenue and the tariffs, with criteria for adjustment and review, and the law creates a supply contingency plan that contracts are required to observe.

fiscal.por: The maximum allowed revenue will not, under any circumstances, be guaranteed by the federal government. The law expressly rules out a public guarantee, without creating revenue, spending or a tax break.

seguranca_juridica.por: The authorisation may be revoked only through due process and on listed grounds; consumption regimes predating 2009 are preserved, authorisations already issued are ratified, and up to five years are given to bring existing contracts into line while preserving the revenue earned.

expressao.por: What the law has is commercial confidentiality and a duty to inform the regulator; it does not deal with content, the press, advertising or personal data.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.300, de 6 de janeiro de 2022
marcos.nome: Marco Legal da Geração Distribuída (Minigeração e Microgeração)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes the legal framework for distributed micro- and mini-generation of electricity, creates the Sistema de Compensação de Energia Elétrica (SCEE) and the Programa de Energia Renovável Social (PERS), allowing consumers to generate power on a small scale and offset the surplus in the distribution grid.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa parlamentar (PL 5829/2019, autor: deputado Silas Câmara, Republicanos/AM, conforme ficha de tramitação); sancionada por Jair Bolsonaro com dois vetos, os quais foram posteriormente derrubados pelo Congresso Nacional em 2022.

acesso.por: Moves into statute the energy offset rule that sat in an ANEEL resolution: the distributor's duty to meet the access request, 60-month validity for the credits, a minimum billable amount with a reduction for those on the Cadastro Único (Single Registry) and a progressive charge of 15% to 90% of the tariff components between 2023 and 2028.

seguranca_juridica.por: Creates the longest transition of the whole set — anyone already generating, or who applied for access within 12 months, stays under the old regime until 31 December 2045 — and starts requiring a minimum of 90 days before any regulatory change in the sector takes effect.

concorrencia.por: Sets in statute the capacity limits for micro and mini generation, requires a performance bond above 500 kW, bars trading in access opinions and splitting a plant to get around the limit, and sets deadlines for entering operation.

fiscal.por: Expired credits revert to tariff moderation, and the CDE (Energy Development Account) starts covering unpaid tariff components at small distributors. It shifts cost between groups of consumers.

investimento.por: A performance bond of 2.5% to 5% of the investment, a requirement of at least one year of solarimetric measurement to authorise a plant, classification as research and energy efficiency and the creation of the Programa de Energia Renovável Social (Social Renewable Energy Programme).

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 10.257, de 10 de julho de 2001
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law regulates arts. 182 and 183 of the Constituição Federal and sets general guidelines for urban policy, governing the use of urban property through instruments such as the master plan, compulsory subdivision or construction, IPTU rising over time and joint urban operations.
marcos.autoria: Origem no Congresso Nacional (PL 5788/1990, com tramitação de mais de dez anos); sancionada por Fernando Henrique Cardoso.

investimento.por: Creates the set of urban planning instruments that federal law did not have — surface rights, the paid grant of building rights, the consortium urban operation, the transfer of building rights, the neighbourhood impact study — and makes the master plan compulsory, with minimum content.

fiscal.por: IPTU (the urban property tax) rising over time for up to five years, with a maximum rate of 15% and exemption and amnesty barred, and expropriation paid in public debt bonds redeemable in ten years. The burden falls on those who do not give the property a social function.

acesso.por: Writes into statute the right to sustainable cities, with housing, sanitation, infrastructure, transport and public services, requires an integrated transport plan in cities of over 500,000 inhabitants and allows urban taxes and tariffs to be differentiated on social interest grounds.

seguranca_juridica.por: Sets deadlines for the notified owner, keeps the deadlines running when the property is transferred, gives the municipality 30 days to exercise pre-emption on pain of the sale being void and classifies the mayor's conduct as administrative improbity in listed cases.

concorrencia.por: Provides for a tender to make use of an expropriated property, for a consortium urban operation with private investors, and for a property consortium. It creates no licence, no barrier to entry and no capital requirement.

expressao.por: Makes the neighbourhood impact study documents public and makes the master plan conditional on public hearings and on access by any interested party. It is publicity of a public act, not a rule about content.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.848, de 25 de junho de 2019
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law addresses the management, organization, decision-making process and social oversight of the federal regulatory agencies, requiring a Regulatory Impact Analysis (AIR) before the issuing or amendment of normative acts of general interest to economic agents or users.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa do Senado Federal (PLS 52/2013, autor: senador Eunício Oliveira, MDB/CE, conforme ficha de tramitação); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Jair Bolsonaro.

seguranca_juridica.por: Brings into one statute what was scattered across each agency's own law: no hierarchical subordination and fixed-term appointments, collegiate decisions by absolute majority, public and recorded deliberative meetings, compulsory regulatory impact analysis, public consultation of at least 45 days, and the conduct adjustment agreement.

concorrencia.por: Requires impact assessment and public consultation for acts of general interest to economic agents and makes the agencies act in cooperation with the competition authorities, with immediate reporting of any evidence of an infringement and notification by Cade within 48 hours.

acesso.por: Creates an ombudsman's office in each agency, with an ombudsman approved by the Senate, quality targets for the agency's own services and coordination with the consumer protection system. It does not set the tariff or the standard of the regulated service.

investimento.por: A four-year strategic plan, an annual management plan, performance targets and a regulatory agenda — predictability about what the regulator will legislate on, without touching contracts, auctions or guarantees.

fiscal.por: Treats the agency as a sector body of the planning and budget systems, with financial autonomy, and allows part of the revenue collected to be passed on to state and municipal regulators. It redistributes an existing resource.

expressao.por: Requires the recording of meetings to be published within 15 working days, the minutes within 5, the public consultation submissions within 10 and the ombudsman's report on the website. This is disclosure by the regulator, not a rule about third-party content.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.257, de 8 de março de 2016
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law addresses public policies for early childhood, defined as the first 6 completed years or 72 months of a child's life, and amends the Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente and the labor legislation on maternity and paternity leave.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei nº 6.998, de 2013, de autoria do deputado Osmar Terra (PMDB-RS) e outros doze coautores; relatoria de João Ananias (PCdoB-CE) na Comissão Especial da Câmara e de Fátima Bezerra no Plenário do Senado, onde tramitou como PLC nº 14/2015. Aprovado na Câmara em 18/03/2015 e no Senado em 03/02/2016; sancionado por Dilma Rousseff. Correção: este site atribuía antes a lei ao PL 8035/2010, que é outro projeto — o do Plano Nacional de Educação, que virou a Lei 13.005/2014. Fonte: https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/fichadetramitacao?idProposicao=604836

acesso.por: Turns early childhood into enforceable service obligations: early care from 0 to 3, full antenatal, perinatal and postnatal care with the right to a companion, full access to care pathways, free supply of medicines, orthoses and prostheses, a parent or guardian staying throughout a hospital admission, and a standard for nursery facilities.

fiscal.por: Creates a deduction from the tax owed by a company that extends maternity and paternity leave, requires that tax break to be estimated and takes effect only in the following financial year, and earmarks a share of the childhood funds for foster care and integrated early-years care.

seguranca_juridica.por: Amends the CLT to guarantee excused absences for antenatal appointments and for accompanying a child, extends the leaves under the Programa Empresa Cidadã with a rule for applying, defers the effect to the following financial year, and amends the Code of Criminal Procedure on house arrest for pregnant women, mothers and sole responsible fathers.

investimento.por: Requires qualification and continuing training of professionals, adaptation of training courses and infrastructure, accessibility and teaching resources in early intervention services.

expressao.por: Lists among its priorities preventing early exposure to marketing communication, without saying who restricts it, by what procedure or with what penalty, and creates a national system with detailed data on children with no confidentiality rule in the text itself.

concorrencia.por: It does not deal with market entry, licensing, capital, competitive tenders or regulatory cost by size.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.243, de 11 de janeiro de 2016
marcos.nome: Marco Legal de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (CT&I)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law addresses incentives for scientific development, research, scientific and technological capacity-building and innovation, regulating Emenda Constitucional nº 85/2015, and allows cooperation between scientific and technological institutions (ICTs) and companies, including minority State participation in the capital of innovative companies.
marcos.autoria: Origem no Congresso Nacional, tramitando no Senado como Projeto de Lei da Câmara (PLC 14/2015, oriundo de proposta na Câmara dos Deputados); autor parlamentar específico não confirmado com precisão nesta coleta; sancionada por Dilma Rousseff.

investimento.por: Rewrites the instruments for encouraging innovation — economic grants, the technology voucher, the technological order, minority state shareholdings, scholarships — and allows public research infrastructure to be shared with companies in return for consideration.

concorrencia.disp: art. 4 of the act (Law 8,666, art. 24, XXI); Law 10,973: arts. 6, § 1, 19 and 20
concorrencia.por: Creates a waiver of competitive tender for purchases intended for research and development, allows direct contracting in a technological order carrying technological risk, and requires a prior public offer where a licence is granted on an exclusive basis.

fiscal.por: Extends import exemptions to scientific institutions and to companies carrying out projects, gives priority treatment in customs clearance and authorises transferring and reallocating funds between programming categories.

seguranca_juridica.por: Simplifies the signing of the instruments and the accounting for them, requires the public institution to have an innovation policy, sets a deadline of up to one year to pass the economic gains on to the creator, and defines the powers of the technological innovation unit.

acesso.por: Access to public research infrastructure becomes possible in return for financial or non-financial consideration, and the text defines what counts as economic gain from exploitation. This is a price for access to public property, not a tariff charged to the consumer.

expressao.por: There is no confidentiality provision in the technology procurement arrangement; the text deals with intellectual property ownership and with publication of the summary of the technology offer.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.286, de 29 de dezembro de 2021
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law regulates the Brazilian foreign exchange market, Brazilian capital abroad and foreign capital in the country, allowing foreign exchange transactions to be carried out freely, with no limit on amount, through authorized institutions, at an exchange rate freely agreed between the parties.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 5387/2019, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Jair Bolsonaro.

concorrencia.por: Repeals the foreign-exchange framework built up since 1933 and concentrates in the Banco Central the power to authorise, regulate and supervise whoever deals in foreign exchange, with the option of setting differentiated requirements by profile and even waiving authorisation in certain cases.

seguranca_juridica.por: Expressly repeals 38 earlier provisions, refers the penalty procedure to Law 13,506/2017, hands the Banco Central the power to regulate, and comes into force only a year after publication — a long transition for a wholesale change of framework.

acesso.por: The exchange rate becomes freely agreed between the institution and the client, the institution must give the client guidance and technical support, and it is forbidden to demand from the client a document already available in a public or private database.

fiscal.por: Caps the charge for cancelling a foreign exchange contract at 100% of the advance and assigns the forfeited excess amounts to the National Treasury. It creates no tax, tax break or guarantee.

expressao.por: Requires the Banco Central (Central Bank) and its agents to keep individual information confidential and only allows the sharing of data processed so as not to identify the person. This is data confidentiality, without touching content, the press or advertising.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, concessions, amortisation, research or works licensing.

marcos.numero_ato: Decreto nº 12.975, de 20 de maio de 2026
marcos.nome: Decreto de regulamentação do Marco Civil da Internet / ampliação da ANPD
marcos.o_que_mudou: The decree amends Decreto nº 8.771/2016, which regulates Lei nº 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet), creating duties for internet application providers — such as maintaining a legal representative in the country, operating a channel for reporting criminal content and monitoring systemic risks — and expands the powers of the ANPD to regulate, oversee and investigate infractions related to those duties.
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo (decreto regulamentador, que não depende de projeto de lei no Congresso); assinado por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

expressao.por: Creates a notice-and-contestation procedure under which the provider must take down criminal content without a court order — except for crimes against honour and messaging services —, with a duty to curb abusive use of the notice itself and presumed liability for paid advertising. It is a redesign of who takes content off the air. The sign is left open: the STF portal announces a party's suit against the decree, whose number I could not confirm in an accessible source.

seguranca_juridica.disp: arts. 16-B, 16-I, 16-J, 19-A and art. 2 of the decree
seguranca_juridica.por: Swaps liability for an isolated piece of content for the assessment of a systemic failure, bars notifying providers individually to moderate, gives the ANPD the power to regulate and enforce, and comes into force 60 days later. Left open because deadlines, who may notify and the procedure were left to later regulation, and because a case against the decree has been announced.

concorrencia.por: Starts requiring a registered office and a legal representative in the country in order to operate and, in return, allows the authority to set differentiated requirements according to economic size and the risk of the service, particularly for small providers.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or continuity of service.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, guarantees, amortisation or research.

fiscal.por: It creates no revenue, expenditure, tax break, subsidy or guarantee by the Union.

marcos.numero_ato: Decreto nº 12.976, de 20 de maio de 2026
marcos.nome: Decreto sobre proteção de mulheres na internet
marcos.o_que_mudou: The decree sets guidelines for the protection of women on the internet and for tackling violence against women in the digital environment, creating obligations for digital platforms such as the rapid removal of criminal content against women, the blocking of unauthorized 'intimate content' within two hours and safeguards against the generation of synthetic 'intimate content' by artificial intelligence.
marcos.autoria: Ato do Poder Executivo (decreto, que não depende de projeto de lei no Congresso); assinado por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

expressao.por: Requires criminal content to be taken down on notice, without a court order, within a deadline of up to 2 hours for intimate content and of 6 or 24 hours in other cases while there is no regulation, authorises ex officio measures against coordinated attacks and bans the generation of intimate content by artificial intelligence. The dimension records the restriction; the harm it prevents is described in the decree itself and is not erased by this number.

seguranca_juridica.por: Defines intimate content and nine forms of digital violence, gives competence to the ANPD (the data protection authority) and comes into force in 60 days. It does not rise to 3 because the deadlines are expressly transitional until the regulation is issued and the text does not specify a penalty.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or continuity of service.

concorrencia.por: Imposes a duty of conduct on those who offer artificial intelligence functionality, but creates no entry condition, licence, capital requirement or cost by size.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, guarantees or research.

fiscal.por: Creates an inter-ministerial working group, with no revenue, mandatory spending or tax break.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei Complementar nº 101, de 4 de maio de 2000
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law sets public finance rules aimed at the fiscal management of the Union, the States, the Distrito Federal and the Municipalities, setting fiscal targets, limits on personnel spending and on indebtedness and requiring planned and transparent action by the public manager.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PLP 18/1999, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Fernando Henrique Cardoso.

fiscal.por: Creates Brazil's fiscal rule: instituting and collecting every tax within a government's competence becomes a requirement of fiscal responsibility, a tax benefit requires an impact estimate, staff spending gains a ceiling of 50% and 60% of net current revenue with a deadline to clear any excess, and consolidated debt gains a limit and a deadline to return to it.

seguranca_juridica.por: Any act increasing staff spending in the final 180 days of a term is void, whoever fails to return within the limit is barred from receiving voluntary transfers, taking on credit and obtaining guarantees, and the list of those over the limits is published monthly. The sign is left open because the official Planalto text itself refers to ADIs 2238, 7064, 6357 and 6533.

investimento.por: Requires a budgetary impact estimate to create or expand government action, defines mandatory expenditure of a continuing nature, makes credit operations conditional on a cost-benefit opinion and regulates the granting of guarantees by the federal entities.

acesso.por: Among the articles I was able to check in the source — from 1 to 40 — there is no rule on tariffs, coverage or service quality. Arts. 44 to 47, on a controlled company that provides a service for a price or a tariff, were not among them and, under this site's rule, what has not been checked does not become a score.

concorrencia.por: Among the articles checked there is no provision on competitive tender, market entry, authorisation or the State's purchasing power.

expressao.por: The transparency and oversight chapters, arts. 48 to 59, were not among the articles the source returned, and for that reason receive no score here.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 11.079, de 30 de dezembro de 2004
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law sets general rules for the bidding and contracting of public-private partnerships, creating the sponsored concession and administrative concession arrangements, with a minimum contract value, a minimum term and the creation of the Fundo Garantidor de Parcerias Público-Privadas.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 2546/2003, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

investimento.por: Creates the public-private partnership, with a term of 5 to 35 years, an objective allocation of risks including act of God, force majeure and sovereign act, guarantees for the public partner's obligations, and a Guarantee Fund with federal participation capped at R$ 6 billion.

fiscal.por: Puts a ceiling of 1% of net current revenue on the federal government and 5% on states and municipalities for continuing PPP spending, and requires proof that it does not affect the fiscal targets plus an impact estimate per financial year. It conditions and limits the long-term public commitment.

concorrencia.por: Requires a competitive tender by open bidding or competitive dialogue, allows the order of qualification and judgment to be reversed and requires a special purpose company to be set up before the contract, the Administration being barred from holding the majority of the voting capital.

acesso.por: In a sponsored concession the user pays a tariff on top of the payment made by the public authority, and the contract must set out objective performance assessment criteria, with variable remuneration tied to targets and standards.

seguranca_juridica.por: Sets a minimum and a maximum contract period, allocates by contract fortuitous events, force majeure and acts of the State, creates by decree a federal managing body with defined competence and requires states and municipalities to inform the Senate in advance.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 12.485, de 12 de setembro de 2011
marcos.nome: Lei da TV Paga (Comunicação Audiovisual de Acesso Condicionado)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law regulates the provision of conditional-access audiovisual communication services (pay TV), sets obligations for national content and independence between the programming, production and distribution activities, and limits cross-ownership between telecommunications operators and content producers.
marcos.autoria: Origem no Congresso Nacional, no Senado Federal (PLC 116/2010, tramitado como prioridade do governo Dilma); autor parlamentar específico não confirmado com precisão nesta coleta; sancionada com vetos parciais por Dilma Rousseff.

concorrencia.por: Merges cable, MMDS, DTH and TVA into a single service, separates production, programming, packaging and distribution, and bars cross-ownership between telecommunications and broadcasting above fixed percentages. It swaps the sector's arrangement and redistributes what each group may do, rather than simply opening or closing the market.

expressao.por: Puts freedom of expression among the principles, requires a classification notice on all content with enforcement by the Ministry of Justice, subjects advertising to the same limit as broadcasting, restricts Portuguese-language advertising commissioned abroad, and imposes must-carry for free-to-air, Congress, Supreme Court, public, community and university channels. The sign is left open because the official Planalto text carries the note 'Vide ADIN nº 4.679' on the advertising rule itself.

investimento.por: Creates quotas for Brazilian content and for independent Brazilian channels in the packages, channels at least 30% of Condecine revenue to producers in the North, North-East and Centre-West, and sets those obligations to run until 31 December 2038.

fiscal.por: Makes the Condecine (the audiovisual levy) apply to conditional access services, with rates by size, earmarks percentages of the revenue and observes the annual precedence rule, taking effect only in the year following publication.

acesso.por: Creates subscriber rights — dealing only with the access provider, taking just the must-carry channels, cancelling by telephone or online — and requires service on non-discriminatory terms, plus a device to block reception.

seguranca_juridica.por: Creates ANCINE's scale of penalties, preserves existing grants until their terms end with adaptation once the regulation is issued, and staggers entry into force: one year for the cross-ownership rule and four years for one of the quota limits.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 12.846, de 1º de agosto de 2013
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law holds legal entities strictly liable, administratively and civilly, for acts harmful to the public administration, domestic or foreign, providing for fines of 0,1% to 20% of gross revenue and the possibility of leniency agreements.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 6826/2010, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Dilma Rousseff.

seguranca_juridica.por: Creates from nothing the strict liability of a legal person for acts against the public administration, with a procedure of its own, a commission, a 180-day deadline, 30 days to defend, a leniency agreement that interrupts the limitation period, and a five-year limitation period. It comes into force 180 days after publication.

concorrencia.por: Defines as unlawful acts rigging the competitive character of a tender, keeping a bidder out, setting up a shell company and manipulating the contract's financial balance, and bars for one to five years any access to public incentives, grants, subsidies, donations and loans, with entry in a national register.

fiscal.por: A fine of 0.1% to 20% of gross turnover, never lower than the advantage obtained, or of R$ 6,000 to R$ 60 million where turnover cannot be used, assigned preferentially to the body or entity harmed.

expressao.por: Requires the convicted party to publish the decision at its own expense in a widely circulated outlet and by a notice visible at the establishment for at least 30 days — this is compelled speech — and keeps the leniency proposal confidential until the agreement takes effect.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or service quality.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, guarantees, amortisation or research.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.303, de 30 de junho de 2016
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law provides for the legal statute of the public enterprise, the mixed-capital company and their subsidiaries, requiring technical qualifications for directors, a minimum governance structure and committees, and specific rules for bidding and contracting.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa do Senado Federal (PLS 555/2015, autor: senador Fernando Bezerra Coelho, MDB/PE); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Michel Temer, então Vice-Presidente da República no exercício da Presidência durante o afastamento de Dilma Rousseff no processo de impeachment. Sancionada em 30 de junho de 2016, quando Michel Temer exercia a Presidência interinamente: o afastamento definitivo de Dilma Rousseff só se deu em 31 de agosto daquele ano.

concorrencia.por: Creates the state-owned companies' own regime for tenders and contracts, requires prior statutory authorisation grounded in relevant collective interest or national security for the state to run a business, sets limits for waiving a tender, adopts the pregão auction by preference, and bars anyone who drew up the design from taking part.

seguranca_juridica.por: Imposes on state-owned companies governance, internal audit, a statutory audit committee, at least 25% independent board members and internal tendering rules. The sign is left open because the official Planalto text itself refers to ADIs 5624, 5846, 5924, 6029 and 7331 on the law's reach.

investimento.por: Defines the delivery regimes, including semi-integrated and integrated contracting, with a risk matrix and a mandatory basic design outside integrated contracting, and makes the disposal of assets conditional on formal valuation and a competitive tender.

expressao.por: Requires publication of an annual governance letter and of every form of remuneration of the directors, requires the board to set a spokesperson policy — who may speak for the company — and makes the estimated value of the contract confidential, with disclosure only optional and subject to justification. It opens on one side and closes on the other.

acesso.por: Requires action to be directed towards the economically justified expansion of consumer access and requires obligations taken on under conditions different from those of the private sector to be set out in law or regulation and disclosed transparently.

fiscal.por: Uses gross operating revenue of R$ 90 million as the governance threshold, puts the dividend policy among the transparency requirements, and sets value limits for waiving a tender, with overpricing and overbilling barred.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.467, de 13 de julho de 2017
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law amends the Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT), creating types of contract such as intermittent work, widening the scope for collective bargaining over certain rights, changing rules on working hours and on labor-claim limitation periods and modifying procedures in the Justiça do Trabalho.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 6787/2016, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado por Michel Temer.

seguranca_juridica.por: Changes the hierarchy between what is negotiated and what is legislated in fifteen matters, bars the survival of collective agreements beyond their term, caps non-pecuniary damages by bands of the injured party's salary, creates intercurrent limitation and requires transcendence in the appeal on points of law. The sign is left open because the official Planalto text itself carries 'Vide ADIN 5938' and refers to MP 808/2017, which changed part of the provisions and then lapsed.

concorrencia.disp: Law 6,019: arts. 4-A, 5-C and 5-D; CLT: arts. 442-B and 47
concorrencia.por: Frees the outsourcing of any activity, including the client's core activity, with an 18-month cooling-off period for former employees, rules out an employment relationship for a self-employed contractor hired with the formalities met, and grades the fine per unregistered employee according to the size of the firm.

fiscal.disp: CLT: arts. 578 to 602 and 790-B; Law 8,036: art. 20, I-A
fiscal.por: Ends the compulsory nature of the trade union contribution, which now requires prior and express authorisation, makes the Union liable for expert witness fees when the beneficiary of free legal aid has no credits, and allows the FGTS to be withdrawn when the contract is terminated by agreement.

expressao.por: Puts honour, image and privacy among the interests protected in the employment relationship and caps compensation for harm to them, taking into account how publicly the offence was made; and requires a public session, with the agenda published 30 days in advance, for the TST to issue a binding précis.

investimento.por: Guarantees an outsourced worker on the client company's premises the same conditions for meals, transport, medical care and training as the directly employed staff.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or service to the consumer.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.874, de 20 de setembro de 2019
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law establishes the Declaração de Direitos de Liberdade Econômica, setting guarantees of free enterprise, exemption from prior licensing for low-risk activities and tacit approval of administrative applications after a period set in regulation, and also amends the Código Civil and corporate legislation.
marcos.autoria: Conversão da Medida Provisória nº 881, de 2019, de iniciativa do Poder Executivo; aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionada por Jair Bolsonaro.

concorrencia.disp: arts. 3, I, IX and XII, 4, 9 and 14
concorrencia.por: Waives the public clearance act for low-risk activity, creates tacit approval once the deadline has passed, lists what now counts as abuse of regulatory power — market reserve, barrier to entry, unnecessary technical specification — and sets deadlines of 2 and 5 working days at the commercial registry, on pain of automatic filing.

seguranca_juridica.disp: Civil Code: arts. 49-A, 50, 113, 421 and 421-A; arts. 2, 3, V and § 11, 4-A and 5
seguranca_juridica.por: Writes minimum intervention and the exceptional nature of contractual review into statute, restricts piercing of the corporate veil to misuse of purpose and commingling of assets, presumes the business contract to be balanced and symmetrical and makes regulatory impact analysis mandatory.

investimento.por: Gives a legal basis to the contractual allocation of risks in long-term contracts and treats the investment fund as a special co-ownership, with assets segregated by classes of units and limited liability for unit-holders and service providers.

fiscal.por: Creates binding precedent statements of the federal tax administration, waives contestation and appeal by the PGFN (the Office of the Attorney-General of the National Treasury) in listed cases, bars charging a public fee to wind up a company and replaces eSocial with simplified digital bookkeeping.

acesso.por: Guarantees the freedom to set the price in an unregulated market and to choose opening hours and days, subject to tax legislation and competition legislation. It does not touch the regulated tariff or universalisation.

expressao.por: Includes among the acts of abuse of regulatory power restricting the use and exercise of advertising and publicity concerning an economic sector.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.711, de 30 de outubro de 2023
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law improves the rules on the treatment of credit and of collateral, allowing the out-of-court enforcement of claims secured by mortgage and the out-of-court search and seizure procedure for movable assets under fiduciary sale in the event of default.
marcos.autoria: Projeto do Poder Executivo (PL 4188/2021, autor: Poder Executivo, conforme ficha de tramitação da Câmara dos Deputados); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (parte dos vetos foi posteriormente derrubada pelo Congresso Nacional).

seguranca_juridica.por: Creates out-of-court enforcement of debt secured by mortgage and out-of-court seizure of movable property, with a procedure, deadlines, a right to redeem and a ranking of creditors by priority. The sign is left open because central parts of art. 8-C appear as vetoed in the official Planalto text, which also records the promulgation of vetoed parts, and I could not confirm from the source which wording is in force.

investimento.por: Allows a security interest already created to be extended and reused for new credit operations, creates the security agent with a fiduciary duty and segregated assets, and makes the counter-guarantee contract an out-of-court enforceable instrument. It changes how much credit the same asset supports.

concorrencia.por: As a rule the security interest is extended with the original creditor, and transfer to a different institution is allowed only in narrow cases. This conditions competition for customers and the portability of the credit.

acesso.por: Creates the occupancy fee owed by the debtor after consolidation, a special procedure for residential mortgage lending, and rules on notarial fees and on a negotiated solution before formal protest. It raises the cost of defaulting and speeds up the loss of the asset.

fiscal.por: Makes amounts held in a notarial escrow account segregated assets, not attachable by a judicial or tax authority for an obligation unrelated to the transaction, opens an exception in the Fundeb, and changes the taxation of unit-holders resident abroad.

expressao.por: Makes the consolidation and the freezing of the asset public by notice, electronic means and the notaries' national registry. It is compulsory publicity of an act that affects the debtor's credit reputation.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.790, de 29 de dezembro de 2023
marcos.nome: Lei das Bets (regulamentação das apostas de quota fixa)
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law regulates fixed-odds betting as a lottery arrangement, requiring prior authorization from the Ministério da Fazenda in order to operate, and sets rules on advertising, protection of bettors and supervision with administrative penalties.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei nº 3.626, de 2023, de iniciativa do Poder Executivo; relatoria de Adolfo Viana (PSDB-BA) na Câmara e do senador Angelo Coronel (PSD-BA) no Senado. Aprovado na Câmara em 13/09/2023 e no Senado em 12/12/2023; sancionado com vetos por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, vetos rejeitados pelo Congresso em 09/05/2024 e as partes vetadas promulgadas em 22/05/2024. Correção: este site dizia antes que a lei era conversão da Medida Provisória nº 1.182/2023 — não é. O Executivo enviou a MP e o projeto no mesmo dia, 25/07/2023; o Congresso votou o projeto e deixou a MP caducar, o que ocorreu em 22/11/2023 sem apreciação de nenhuma das duas Casas. A MP é antecedente, não origem. Fonte: https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/fichadetramitacao?idProposicao=2374400

fiscal.por: It created the sector's revenue from nothing: a licence fee, tax on winnings, and earmarking of the proceeds for social security, sport, tourism, public safety and education. Before the law, fixed-odds betting operated with no regular federal revenue. This redesigns the sector's fiscal rule.

concorrencia.por: It required prior authorisation from the Finance Ministry, with minimum share capital and a partner domiciled in the country, in order to operate. That closes entry to those operating without authorisation and opens it to those who meet the requirements: it swaps the entry regime, and the sign records redistribution among operators, not an expansion or a restriction of the market as a whole.

seguranca_juridica.por: It set the deciding authority, the authorisation procedure, deadlines and administrative penalties where the activity had had no defined regime. It changes the rule across the sector. The reach does not rise to 3 because central parts were left to Finance Ministry regulation, issued in 2024 and 2025.

acesso.por: It created bettor-protection duties that had not existed: identifying the bettor, barring under-18s and people with a gambling-related disorder, and rules on advertising. These are enforceable standards for the quality and continuity of the service to the user.

expressao.por: It restricted the sector's advertising — what may be advertised, to whom and with what warning. A restriction on advertising is a restriction on commercial expression, and is recorded as such, which does not imply the restriction is improper: the same article is what protects minors.

investimento.por: The minimum share capital and domicile requirements create a capital threshold for operating, but the act does not deal with long-term contracts, auctions, guarantees or research incentives. It only grazes the dimension.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 15.097, de 10 de janeiro de 2025
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law governs the use of offshore energy potential, setting rules for grants by authorization or concession for power generation in inland waters, the territorial sea, the exclusive economic zone and the continental shelf.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de iniciativa do Senado Federal (PL 576/2021, autor: senador Jean Paul Prates, PT/RN); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

concorrencia.por: Creates from nothing the grant to use federal property at sea to generate energy: authorisation through the standing offer, with a public call of at least 120 days, or concession through the planned offer, with a tender decided by the highest government take bid.

fiscal.por: Creates its own government takes — a signature bonus, an occupation fee per square kilometre per year and a monthly proportional share of the energy generated — and splits the revenue between the Union, bordering states and municipalities, participation funds and affected communities.

investimento.por: Splits the grant into an assessment phase and an execution phase, with targets and termination without reimbursement if viability is not declared, requires a decommissioning clause that survives abandonment, creates specific auctions for offshore energy and transmission and applies the occupation fee primarily to research and innovation.

acesso.por: The grant does not confer the right to run the service without ANEEL authorisation, imposes environmental conservation and monitoring at every stage, and extends by up to 20 years the contracts of small hydro plants, biomass and wind farms with a price cap indexed to the IPCA. The sign is left open because Congress overrode the veto on that extension and the Executive had argued, in the veto message, that it would raise subsidies and tariffs.

seguranca_juridica.por: Preserves earlier grants for the term of their instruments, lists the grounds for termination, makes the regulation and its deadlines depend on a CNPE decision, and orders the concession and tender laws to apply subsidiarily where they do not conflict.

expressao.por: Creates a Brazilian offshore energy inventory in a publicly accessible database, allowing a confidentiality period to be set for disclosure.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 15.190, de 8 de agosto de 2025
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law regulates item IV of paragraph 1 of art. 225 of the Constituição Federal and sets general guidelines for environmental licensing, creating differentiated procedures (ordinary three-phase, simplified two-phase, single-phase and by adhesion) and maximum administrative deadlines for the licenses.
marcos.autoria: Origem na Câmara dos Deputados (PL 2159/2021, autores: deputados Luciano Zica, PT/SP, Walter Pinheiro, PT/BA, Zezéu Ribeiro, PT/BA, e outros); aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

concorrencia.por: Unifies in federal law the types of licence, the waivers and the exemptions, creates the licence by self-declaration and commitment for low and medium impact with sample-based review, sets maximum review periods per type of licence, and requires fees to be proportionate to the cost and complexity of the review.

investimento.por: Sets validity periods for the licences, creates automatic renewal by self-declaration for low and medium impact, extends by up to 100% the period for those adopting innovative technology, creates a special procedure with a dedicated team for strategic projects and the corrective operating licence for those already operating without one.

seguranca_juridica.por: Makes the views of Funai, the Fundação Palmares and the managers of conservation units expressly non-binding, with deadlines, and states that letting the maximum deadline pass does not create a tacit licence. The sign is left open: there were 63 vetoes on signature, Congress overrode 52 items, ICMBio published an official note against the override, and there are three party-led cases at the STF, whose numbers I could not confirm in an accessible source.

acesso.por: Gives priority and a simplified procedure to water supply, sewage services and energy security, waives licensing of treatment systems until the sanitation universalisation targets are met and treats hydroelectric plants and reservoirs as strategic for water and energy security.

expressao.por: Requires applications, decisions, studies and appeals to be published on a website, makes the environmental impact study public in nature, and requires a public hearing with the EIA/Rima available 45 days beforehand and a public consultation of 15 to 60 days.

fiscal.por: Puts the cost of licensing — studies, hearings, publications, conditions — on the developer and makes the certificate of non-applicability free of charge. It creates no revenue, tax break or federal guarantee.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 15.269, de 24 de novembro de 2025
marcos.nome: Novo Marco Regulatório do Setor Elétrico
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law changes the regulatory framework of the electricity sector, dealing with tariff affordability and energy security, sets guidelines for regulating the activity of electricity storage and amends various laws in the sector.
marcos.autoria: Conversão da Medida Provisória nº 1.304, de 2025, de iniciativa do Poder Executivo; aprovada pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionada com mais de dez vetos por Geraldo Alckmin, Vice-Presidente da República no exercício da Presidência.

acesso.por: Opens the free market to smaller consumers over 24 and 36 months, with a supplier of last resort and tariffs of its own, cuts the share of the CDE (Energy Development Account) paid at high and medium voltage, caps that account's revenue from 2027 and spreads the cost of the capacity reserve across all final consumers. The sign is left open because there were 16 vetoes and what survived shifts cost between groups of consumers in opposite directions.

concorrencia.por: Redesigns who may buy energy from whom, creates the supplier of last resort, gives ANEEL the regulation of storage with fines of up to 3% of turnover, and contracts specific reserves, including coal-fired plants with mandatory inflexibility until 2040.

investimento.por: Ends the research and development exemption for wind and solar plants applying for a grant from 2026, extends by up to 30 years the hydro plants granted before 2003 with the hydrological risk assumed and assured energy recalculated, and compensates generators for external unavailability going back to September 2023.

fiscal.por: Caps the revenue of the CDE (Energy Development Account) from 2027 and creates the Resource Top-Up Charge to cover the difference; in the hydro extensions, half the amount goes to the account and half is paid for the grant. It redistributes a charge without creating a tax.

seguranca_juridica.por: Sets a transition of 24 and 36 months, caps the revision of the physical guarantee at 5% per revision and 10% over the whole grant, gives the compensation retroactive effect from September 2023 and bars renegotiating hydrological risk after 12 months. Left open because some of the provisions were vetoed and the final commencement clauses were not among those I was able to check in the source.

expressao.por: Among the articles checked, from 1 to 17, there is no rule on content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 11.941, de 27 de maio de 2009 (conversão da Medida Provisória nº 449, de 3 de dezembro de 2008)
marcos.nome: Voto de qualidade no CARF — 1 de 4: a regra nasce a favor do Fisco
marcos.o_que_mudou: The provisional measure merged the former Taxpayer Councils into the Administrative Council of Tax Appeals (CARF) and added § 9 to art. 25 of Decree no. 70.235/1972, giving the chair of each panel to members representing the National Treasury and granting them the casting vote in the event of a tie. In practice: when a judgment ties, the tax authority's representative decides, and the charge stands. Contrary to what is often said, this rule is not from 1972 — that year's decree had no § 9. What this rule did was undone in 2020 (item 2 of the sequence) and restored in 2023 (item 4).
marcos.autoria: Medida Provisória nº 449, de 3 de dezembro de 2008, editada pelo Poder Executivo; convertida em lei pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionada por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
marcos.serie_item: the rule is born in the Treasury's favour

fiscal.por: Creates instalment payment of federal debts over up to 180 months with fines cut by up to 100%, reopens earlier instalment schemes with a 40% discount and writes off debts overdue for five years or more up to R$ 10,000. It redesigns the collection of federal tax debt for the period.

seguranca_juridica.disp: art. 25 (new wording of art. 25 of Decree 70,235/1972)
seguranca_juridica.por: Structures CARF as a second-instance collegiate body with equal representation, chaired by the representatives of the National Treasury, with the vice-presidency held by the taxpayers and the chair holding the casting vote in a tie. This is where the tie-breaking rule is born in favour of the tax authorities — the starting point of the three milestones that follow.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or service quality.

concorrencia.por: It does not deal with market entry, licensing, capital, competitive tenders or cost by size.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, guarantees, amortisation or research.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 13.988, de 14 de abril de 2020, art. 28
marcos.nome: Voto de qualidade no CARF — 2 de 4: o empate passa a favorecer o contribuinte
marcos.o_que_mudou: Art. 28 added art. 19-E to Law no. 10.522/2002, in these words: ‘In the event of a tie in the judgment of administrative proceedings assessing and demanding a tax credit, the casting vote referred to in § 9 of art. 25 of Decree no. 70.235 of 6 March 1972 does not apply, and the matter is resolved in the taxpayer's favour.’ It therefore reversed the outcome of a tie. It reversed the rule created in 2009 (item 1 of the sequence). It was the provision that the January 2023 provisional measure (item 3) tried to repeal and that the September 2023 law (item 4) actually repealed.
marcos.autoria: O dispositivo não veio do Executivo. A Medida Provisória nº 899/2019, que deu origem à lei, tratava apenas de transação tributária e não mencionava voto de qualidade nem o art. 19-E. O desempate a favor do contribuinte entrou por emenda parlamentar durante a conversão (PLV nº 2/2020, relator deputado Marco Bertaiolli, em meio a 221 emendas). Jair Bolsonaro sancionou sem vetar esse artigo — o ato do Executivo aqui foi a sanção, não a iniciativa.
marcos.serie_item: the tie starts favouring the taxpayer

fiscal.por: Creates the tax settlement scheme, with a discount of up to 65% and payment over up to 120 months, and has a tie in administrative judgment resolved in favour of the taxpayer, which means the tax debt is no longer definitively constituted at that level. It reduces revenue already assessed.

seguranca_juridica.por: Sets aside the casting vote without repealing the 2009 provision, changing who bears the burden of doubt in administrative tax proceedings, and makes the operation of the settlement regime depend on sub-statutory acts. The sign is left open because the STF's own portal announces cases against the end of the casting vote, whose numbers I could not confirm in an accessible source.

concorrencia.por: Provides a longer period, up to 145 months, and a bigger discount, up to 70%, for a small company — the cost of regularising graded by the size of the debtor.

acesso.por: It does not deal with price, tariffs, coverage, universal service or service quality.

investimento.por: It does not deal with long contracts, auctions, guarantees, amortisation or research.

expressao.por: It does not deal with content, confidentiality, the press or advertising.

marcos.numero_ato: Medida Provisória nº 1.160, de 12 de janeiro de 2023
marcos.nome: Voto de qualidade no CARF — 3 de 4: tentativa de volta por medida provisória, que caduca
marcos.o_que_mudou: Issued in the second week of the term, the provisional measure ordered ties to be decided under § 9 of art. 25 of Decree 70.235/1972 — back to the tax authority — and repealed, in art. 5, art. 19-E of Law 10.522/2002. It was never voted on: the government dropped it on 11 April 2023 and moved to a bill instead, and the measure lapsed without conversion. In the meantime, the rule favouring the taxpayer applied again. It sought to undo the 2020 rule (item 2 of the sequence). Because it lapsed, the repeal was made by the law of September that same year (item 4) — and that difference matters: it is one thing for the Executive to repeal on its own by provisional measure, another for Congress to approve the repeal.
marcos.autoria: Medida provisória editada pelo Poder Executivo, assinada por Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e pelo ministro Fernando Haddad. Registrada no Congresso Nacional como ‘sem eficácia’, com 89 emendas apresentadas e nenhuma votação.
marcos.serie_item: an attempt to return by provisional measure, which lapses

seguranca_juridica.disp: arts. 1 and 5, and the Planalto page's note that it is no longer in force
seguranca_juridica.por: Repeals art. 19-E and reinstates the casting vote by provisional measure, with immediate effect — and the measure lapses without being converted into law, which leaves open what applies to the rulings made in the meantime. The STF's portal announces party-led cases against the measure, whose numbers I could not confirm in an accessible source.

fiscal.por: The tie is once again decided in favour of the National Treasury and, until 30 April 2023, late-payment and ex officio fines are waived for those who confess and pay before the tax debt is constituted. A tax break with a closed deadline, in exchange for revenue preserved.

marcos.numero_ato: Lei nº 14.689, de 20 de setembro de 2023
marcos.nome: Voto de qualidade no CARF — 4 de 4: a volta por lei, com exclusão de multas
marcos.o_que_mudou: The law repealed art. 19-E of Law 10.522/2002 (art. 17, II) and determined that a tie is once again decided under § 9 of art. 25 of Decree 70.235/1972, in the Treasury's favour. In exchange, it inserted § 9-A into the same article: when the tax authority wins by that tie-break, the fines are cancelled and the criminal tax referral is withdrawn, with only the tax due being charged. That design did not originate in the Executive or in Congress alone: it came from an agreement between the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) and the Ministry of Finance reached on 14 February 2023, within ADI 7347, mediated by Justice Dias Toffoli. It restored, with trade-offs, the rule created in 2009 (item 1 of the sequence), which the 2020 law (item 2) had reversed, and completed what the January provisional measure (item 3) could not.
marcos.autoria: Projeto de Lei nº 2.384/2023, do Poder Executivo, aprovado pelo Congresso Nacional e sancionado com vetos por Geraldo Alckmin, vice-presidente no exercício da Presidência (Mensagem de veto nº 487). Em 14 de dezembro de 2023 o Congresso derrubou cinco desses vetos, restabelecendo, entre outros pontos, o cancelamento das multas que excedam 100% do crédito tributário e a exigência de trânsito em julgado para executar seguro-garantia e fiança bancária — ou seja, a lei em vigor é mais favorável ao contribuinte do que o texto que o Executivo queria.
marcos.serie_item: the return by law, with fines cancelled

fiscal.por: Restores the casting vote by statute and, in return, cancels the fines and the referral for criminal prosecution in cases decided by a tie, waives default interest where payment is made in up to 12 instalments, and cancels any fine exceeding 100% of the tax debt assessed. It keeps the debt and gives value back by another route.

seguranca_juridica.por: Ends by statute the alternation that the lapsed provisional measure had opened, makes the penalty and the criminal referral depend on how the ruling was decided and waives security from a taxpayer able to pay. The sign is left open because the law was sanctioned with extensive vetoes and the STF portal announces a party's suit against it, whose number I could not confirm in an accessible source.
